title: 3-in-1 Electric Makeup Brush Cleaner Machine
descriptionHtml:
Tired of grimy makeup brushes ruining your flawless finish? This 3-in-1 Electric Cosmetic Brush Cleaner deep-cleans, rinses, and dries your brushes in minutes — so every stroke feels fresh, soft, and hygienic.

Why You Need It

Makeup brushes collect oil, foundation residue, and bacteria over time. Hand-washing can leave brushes soggy for hours, and stains don't always lift. This automatic cleaner does the hard work for you with a quick, mess-free cycle that gets your tools looking (and performing) like new.

3 Cleaning Modes in One Compact Device

  • Spinning Wash: A powered base rotates the brush attachment to work cleansing solution deep into bristles.
  • Rinse Cycle: Swaps to a clean-water bowl to flush out soap and loosened makeup.
  • Quick-Dry Function: A built-in spin-dry mode whisks away excess water so brushes are ready to use again fast.

Key Features

  • Compatible with most brush sizes — from small eyeshadow brushes to large powder and foundation brushes.
  • Includes multiple silicone attachments / holders to fit different handle diameters.
  • USB-powered for convenient use on a vanity, bathroom counter, or while travelling.
  • Compact, lightweight design with a stable non-slip base.
  • Simple one-button operation — no complicated setup.

How to Use

  1. Attach the appropriate silicone collar to the spin base and secure your brush handle.
  2. Add a few drops of brush cleanser (or gentle soap) and a little warm water to the bowl.
  3. Lower the brush into the solution and press the button to spin and wash.
  4. Rinse in clean water, then spin again to remove excess moisture.
  5. Set brushes flat to finish air-drying — most are ready within a few hours.

What's in the Box

  • 1 × Electric Brush Cleaner Base
  • Multiple silicone brush holders (various sizes)
  • USB power cable
  • Instruction manual

Care Tips

  • Empty and wipe the bowl after each use to prevent soap buildup.
  • Do not submerge the motorized base in water.
  • Use a mild brush cleanser to extend the life of both the device and your brushes.

Whether you're a daily foundation wearer or a weekend glam enthusiast, this little machine keeps your kit clean, your skin happier, and your makeup looking its best — without the elbow grease.

descriptionHtml:
Enjoy a warm, home-style meal anywhere with this 3-in-1 Electric Lunch Box. Designed for busy Canadians who want a hot lunch without relying on a workplace microwave, this compact unit heats, steams, and keeps your food at a comfortable eating temperature using a simple plug-in design.

Three Functions in One Unit

  • Heating Mode: Gently warms pre-cooked meals, leftovers, soups, stews, and casseroles straight from the fridge.
  • Steaming Mode: Steam vegetables, dumplings, eggs, or rice for a fresh-cooked taste at your desk or on the road.
  • Warming/Keep-Warm Mode: Maintains a steady, food-safe temperature so your meal stays hot until you're ready to eat.

Key Features

  • Durable food-grade inner container with removable stainless steel or PP tray for easy serving
  • Sealed, leak-resistant lid to prevent spills in your bag or vehicle
  • Includes a built-in power cord compatible with standard North American 110V outlets, plus a 12V car adapter for use in trucks, RVs, and road trips
  • Compact, stackable design with an included cutlery compartment
  • Low-power consumption — typically uses less energy than a small kettle per meal

How to Use

  1. Place your pre-cooked or raw food into the inner container.
  2. Add a small amount of water to the heating tray if steaming.
  3. Close the lid and connect the power cord to a wall outlet (or the 12V car adapter).
  4. Press the power button — indicator light shows when the unit is heating.
  5. Wait approximately 20–30 minutes for typical meals to reach a hot, ready-to-eat temperature.
  6. Unplug, open, and enjoy. The inner tray is removable for easy serving and washing.

Ideal For

  • Office workers without access to a shared microwave
  • Truck drivers, delivery drivers, and long-haul commuters
  • Students in dorms or classrooms
  • Construction sites, workshops, and outdoor job locations
  • Camping, road trips, and overnight travel

Care & Safety

  • Hand-wash the inner container and lid with warm, soapy water — not dishwasher safe
  • Do not submerge the heating base in water
  • Always unplug when not in use and before cleaning
  • Use only the supplied power cord and adapters

descriptionHtml:
Three Grooming Tasks, One Handy Tool

Tackle everyday pet grooming without the hassle of a full bath. This 3-in-1 brush combines steam freshening, bristle brushing, and gentle massage in a single handheld device, helping keep your dog or cat's coat cleaner, softer, and easier to manage between washes.

How the Three Functions Work

  • Steam Cleaning: Releases a fine, warm mist that loosens surface dirt, dander, and trapped debris. A quick way to freshen up fur, paws, and bellies without a sink or tub.
  • Brush Bristles: Soft, flexible bristles glide through the coat to lift loose hair, reduce shedding around the home, and gently work through minor tangles.
  • Massage Nodes: Rounded tips stimulate the skin and support healthy circulation. Most pets find the massaging action relaxing, which makes grooming sessions easier.

Everyday Benefits

  • Great for spot-cleaning muddy paws, bellies, and hindquarters

  • Handheld and corded for consistent steam output

Good to Know Before You Use It

  • Best suited for short-to-medium coat breeds; very thick or long coats may need extra passes
  • Use distilled water when possible to reduce mineral buildup in the steam chamber
  • Always test the steam on your hand first to confirm a comfortable temperature
  • Empty and air-dry the water tank after each use to keep the unit hygienic
  • Introduce the brush slowly — let your pet sniff it and reward calm behavior

Whether you're dealing with shedding season or just want a quicker way to freshen up after a walk, this brush is a simple, no-fuss addition to your pet care routine.

descriptionHtml:
Make Every Outdoor Moment a Little More Bubbly

This oversized 32-hole smiling face bubble wand turns an ordinary backyard, park, or beach afternoon into an instant party. Dip, wave, and watch a curtain of bubbles pour out at once — way more impressive than a standard single-loop wand and a guaranteed hit with kids and grown-ups alike.

Why You'll Like It

  • 32 holes at once: Produces a wide stream of bubbles in a single wave, so you spend less time dipping and more time playing.
  • Smiling face design: Cheerful, kid-friendly look that doubles as a fun photo prop for parties and playdates.
  • Oversized wand head: Larger surface area means fuller, longer-lasting bubble clusters compared to pocket-sized wands.
  • Lightweight build: Easy for small hands to swing without getting tired after a few minutes.
  • Random color assortment: We pick a fun surprise for you — colors ship in assorted styles and may vary from what is pictured.

Good For

  • Backyard play and garden parties
  • Birthday parties, baby showers, and outdoor celebrations
  • Beach days, picnics, and camping trips
  • Wedding send-offs and photo shoots
  • Sensory play and outdoor screen-free fun

How to Use

  1. Pour bubble solution into a shallow tray or dish (a wide plate works great).
  2. Dip the face of the wand fully into the solution and lift it straight out.
  3. Hold the wand in front of you and gently wave or walk forward to release a cascade of bubbles.
  4. Rinse the wand with clean water after play and let it air dry to keep the holes clear.

Good to Know

  • Color: Sent at random — we cannot accommodate specific color requests.
  • Bubble solution: Sold separately. Any standard bubble fluid works; a dish soap and water mix also does the trick in a pinch.
  • Recommended age: Suitable for kids ages 3 and up. Younger children should be supervised — bubbles can be slippery and solution should not go in the eyes or mouth.
  • Care: Wipe down after use and store indoors to extend the life of the wand.

title: 32ft LED Strip Light - Flexible RGB Color Changing Tape Light with
descriptionHtml:
Light Up Any Space with 32 Feet of Flexible LED Strip

Add instant ambiance to your home, office, or entertainment setup with this versatile 32ft LED strip light. The flexible tape design bends around corners and contours, making it easy to install under cabinets, behind TVs, along ceilings, under staircases, or around shelving. A strong adhesive backing keeps the strip firmly in place on clean, dry surfaces.

Key Features

  • Length: 32 feet (9.75 m) of continuous LED tape for generous coverage in larger rooms or multi-zone setups
  • LED Type: Energy-efficient SMD LEDs with long-lasting performance
  • Color Options: Multiple color modes and brightness levels (varies by model) for mood lighting, accent lighting, or party setups
  • Flexible Design: Cuttable at marked intervals to fit custom lengths without damaging the strip
  • Adhesive Backing: Pre-applied 3M-style tape for peel-and-stick installation — no tools required
  • Power: Plug-in adapter included for simple, reliable power (no batteries needed)
  • Control: Remote control or in-line controller for adjusting color, brightness, and mode

Common Uses

  • Under-cabinet kitchen lighting
  • Behind TV or monitor bias lighting
  • Bedroom headboard or ceiling accent
  • Home office and gaming setups
  • Bookshelves, display cases, and bar areas
  • Stair treads and hallway trim

Installation Tips

Before applying, wipe the surface clean with rubbing alcohol and let it dry fully. Press firmly along the entire strip for 30 seconds to ensure a strong bond. Avoid mounting on textured, wet, or porous surfaces. The strip can be cut only at the marked copper contact points — once cut, the trimmed end should be properly sealed if used in damp areas.

What's in the Box

  • 1 x 32ft LED strip light roll
  • 1 x Power adapter
  • 1 x Remote control or inline controller (model dependent)
  • Mounting clips (where applicable)

title: Apnea Tongue Stabilizing Device
descriptionHtml:
Anti Snore TSD (Tongue Stabilizing Device) is a simple, inexpensive and non-invasive solution to problem snoring and Obstructive Sleep Apnea.

It is a simple, one-size-fits-all solution that employs tongue displacement technology.

You don't have to mould or trim it, and no jaw modifications are required.

It is perfect for denture wearers because no pressure is given to your gums, jaw, or teeth. It is also a pleasant option for those who find it difficult to adjust to the jaw positioning of a MAD.

Control your tongue…Prevent the snore

The Anti Snore TSD is a brilliant simple, effective and noninvasive anti-snoring medical device. It provides an easy solution for the treatment of snoring problem.

Traditional mandibular advancement devices indirectly move the tongue forward by moving the mandible. But Anti Snore TSD gently suctions to the tip of the tongue, preventing it from falling back into the throat and obstructing the airway. In addition it prevents clenching and tooth grinding by positioning the tongue between the upper and lower teeth.

  

Made of soft medical-grade silicone, Anti Snore TSD is a one size fits all model. The Anti Snore TSD requires no impressions, no adjustments and has no moving parts. Best of all, it is indicated for anyone — even those with TMJ issues and the edentulous.

How to use it?

  • Place the TSD in your mouth i.e., it should rest between your front teeth and the lips. The protruding bulb is outside of your mouth.
  • The side with the small cut on the TSD should go to the bottom side of the mouth.
  • Squeeze the bulb to let out air.
  • Place your tongue in the tube and release the bulb. This creates suction vacuum and your tongue attaches to the bulb area of the TSD.

What causes snoring?

Snoring is caused by a narrowing of the upper airway during sleep. This can be due to large tonsils, a soft palate, a long uvula or excessive flabby tissue at the throat. All of these areas relax during sleep.

In other cases, nasal congestion from allergies or deformities of the cartilage between the two sides of the nose can contribute to narrowing of the airway.

By keeping the airway open, air travels more slowly, reducing throat vibrations and diminishing or eliminating problem snoring. Holding the tongue forward is one of the most effective ways of keeping the airway open during sleep.

However, the most common cause of narrowing of the upper airway is a tongue muscle that becomes too relaxed during sleep. When relaxed, it gets sucked back into the throat with each breath taken.

Because snoring occurs when air travels faster through a narrow tube than through a broad one, this rapidly moving air causes the relaxed soft tissues of the throat to vibrate. It is this vibration that creates the sound of snoring.

Common causes of snoring

  • Supine body position (lying face up)
  • Large tonsils, long soft palate or uvula
  • A tongue that relaxes too much during sleep
  • Being overweight
  • Nasal congestion from colds, allergies or deformities of cartilage within the nose
  • Menopause
  • Consuming alcohol, medication or tobacco products within six hours of going to sleep
  • Hypothyroidism

Who snores?

More than 60 percent of the adult population suffers from problem snoring. This percentage increases each year in people aged 50 and older, as tissues in the upper airway lose elasticity and tend to vibrate more during breathing, increasing the incidence of snoring when the airway is reduced during sleep, the tongue is more easily sucked into the back of the throat and obstructs the airway.

  • Sixty percent of men and 40 percent of women over the age of 40 are habitual snorers.
  • Snoring is common in children between the age of 2 to 7, particularly if they have a chest infection or enlarged tonsils.
  • Snoring is also commonly experienced by women during the later stages of pregnancy.

Health Benefits:

If left untreated sleep apnea can result in growing number of health problems, some of them include:

  1. High Blood Pressure
  2. Heart Stroke
  3. Heart Failure, Irregular Heartbeats, Heart Attack 
  4. Diabetes 
  5. Depression
  6. Worsening of ADHD

title: Bug Detector - Hidden Camera and Microphones Detector
descriptionHtml:
Keep Your Privacy Secured

Ever feel like someone is watching you? Do you suspect someone knows what's happening when they are not there? Then it would help if you had a camera detector. In the ever-progressing tech driven world, cameras have become smaller and easier for criminals to get their hands on.

They could be in a clock, a television, or even a tiny hole in a ceiling, but they have a weakness; each has a lens and a lens finder exploits this. It doesn't matter how well hidden the video recorder is; the lens finder on this device will find it, even if it is turned off.

Our bug detector allows you to locate wireless frequencies like bugs, audio transmitters, illegal wireless tapping devices, or hidden wireless cameras. With the built-in lens finder, you can detect wired or wireless cameras whether the cameras are turned on or not.

Find one, find them all. This is the latest in hidden camera finding technology. This dual search tool is designed specifically to quickly locate hidden cameras lenses without the need for expensive bug detectors. It is compact, great for travel, easy to operate, and will identify any covert camera.

It doesn't matter if the intrusive recording device is on, off, hardwired, or wireless. It will locate the exact position of the lens.

Also, the built-in RF detector can detect wireless frequencies in the range of 1 MHz-6.5 GHz. Perfect for identifying if a wireless camera or bug is transmitting in the area.

See the red viewport at the top of the detector? You look through it and hit the 'blink' button on the side this makes the LEDs blink outward towards whatever you're looking at. The bright red light bounces off of pinhole cameras lenses, which then goes back to the viewport you're looking through. It's very obvious when you've found a lens, which you can then closely investigate.

Before sweeping for bugs or hidden cameras, unplug and disconnect all WiFi connections, routers, cell phones, and other wireless devices so their signals won't interfere with your sweep.

When using a hidden camera finder, split the room to be searched into quadrants. Then, sweep one quadrant at a time. This assures that you more fully check all areas of the room.

descriptionHtml:
Eating healthy is important, but what happens when the healthy food we want to eat has nasty chemicals on top of them?

Pesticides and other harmful chemicals used to grow the nutritious fruits and vegetables we love are not intended for human consumption. Additionally, while producers make an effort to rinse them before selling them to us, they frequently fall short in this regard. Your household will start eating clean, sterile fruits and veggies thanks to the capsule vegetable washing machine. Simply place it in a sink of water after charging it, and it will clean your fruit using electrolysis and only water - no chemicals ever!

Features:

This device requires USB charging in order to function. This is fantastic because there are no wires and you can avoid getting your hands wet as well!

Protect everyone's health at home by using electrolysis technology, which cleans without chemicals and just with water and electrolysis.

Take the washing machine with you wherever you go to make sure your food is clean. You can quickly clean fruits and veggies using just a large bowl or sink, water, and a few other ingredients. From now on, eat carefully!

Benefits:

Food that has been sterilised and thoroughly cleaned may still have pesticide and other chemical residues. These are dangerous to people. With this washing machine, you don't have to worry about them.

Easy to Use: Having clean fruit and vegetables requires the use of this gadget, which is both simple to use and indispensable. When you return from shopping, even your kids will be able to utilise it.

Chemical-Free: Cleaning our food with additional chemicals would be much worse than having chemicals on it! This washing machine is ideal because it uses water to clean rather than harsh chemicals.

How To Use:

  1. Fully charge on docking station before first use. When charging, the green light flashes. When charging is complete, the green light will stay solid (stop flashing).
  2. Place fruit and vegetables in a sink with clean, fresh water (temperature at or below 40°F). It is recommended to not exceed 101.4oz of water.
  3. Put fruit and vegetable washing machine at the bottom of the sink and keep them submerged.
  4. During the working period, occasionally stir the fruit and vegetables around to enhance cleaning.
  5. During the operation of the machine, electrolyzed water may smell of disinfectant or detergent, which is normal. It is not using any of these though.
  6. After the fruit and vegetable machine is finished, you will hear 3 beeps and all indicator lights will go out. At this time, let the fruits and vegetables in the vegetable washing basin stand for 5-10 minutes to fully receive the effects of the electrolysis.
  7. Finally, take the fruits and vegetables out with clean water and rinse once more.

The Energy Saver is safe to use, whatever your home or electrical installation.

Using the Energy Saver Box at home is entirely legal.

title: 5AM Club - Infinity Planner
descriptionHtml:
Please note: Actual product colors may vary slightly due to materials, lighting, and screen differences.

Step up your planning game with the Infinity Planner!

It's a planner, but not as you know it—undated, unpretentious, and totally under your control.

Wrapped in sleek vegan saffiano leather and secured with a sleek magnetic clasp, it's durable enough to handle coffee spills and life's little oops moments.

Inside, you'll find a world where dates don't dictate your schedule. You start when you want, how you want.

Need to mark your spot? Two ribbons are at your service—because one is never enough.

Flip to the back, and voilà: a yearly calendar sheet (hello, 2026) and a smart metal time tag to clip on and show time who's the boss. And for everything else? Slide it into the handy back pocket—no more crinkled notes or lost receipts!

Whether you're a dreamer, a doer, or a bit of both, the Infinity Planner is your stylish sidekick in a world that won't stand still.

Features:

  • Page size: A5 (148 x 210 mm/5.8 x 8.3 in).
  • 144 pages to plan it all!
  • 100 gsm ivory paper thick enough to protect against ink bleeding.
  • FSC-certified paper to preserve the natural ecosystem.
  • Silk-feel paper texture for pens to glide through smoothly.
  • Vegan faux leather front hardcover with unique stylish designs.
  • Black back cover with gold metallic logo.
  • Built-in back pocket to stash your extras.
  • Metallic time tag: get each month’s days sorted
  • Planners covers dimensions: 151 x 216 x 17 mm/5.9 x 8.5 x 0.7 in.
  • Superior flat-lay binding—no more battling with pages that won't stay put!
  • Secure magnetic flap to keep everything private.
  • 2 black ribbon page markers.
  • Product weight: 454 g/16.01 oz.
  • NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

Small but mighty. Stylish but practical. Meet the new and improved BURGA Magnetic Power Bank, your pocket-sized savior with a 5,000 / 10,000 / 15,000 mAh punch. It's made to keep you charged and turning heads wherever you go.

Some newer Android phones may support wireless charging, but they will not attach magnetically, and alignment is not guaranteed. For all other phones and full charging compatibility, use the included USB-C cable.

  • BURGA Power Banks are not CCC certified and may not be allowed through airport security checks in China.

  • Dual Charging: Charge two devices at once, wirelessly and with a cable.

  • Safety First: Overcharge, over-current, and short-circuit protection with CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications.

descriptionHtml:

Smartphones keep growing, but our hands? Not so much. It's a digital juggling act. And let's face it, a dropped phone is a heartbreak no case can fully cushion. So why risk a fumble when you can avoid it?

Meet the BURGA Phone Ring Holder: the tiny hero your phone didn't know it needed. Pop it on the back of your phone, loop a finger through, and voilà! — your tech stays in place, effortlessly. Now that's what we call hands-on security.

Bonus points:

  • You can use it as a stand.
  • Extra stylish & cute.
  • Ultra-strong 3M VHB adhesive pad.
  • No sticky residue after detaching.

* NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

* Optimized for smooth, hard-shelled cases. Does not stick to rubberized or textured materials.

* Designed for one-time use, offering strong support for your device. Once removed, our Ring Holders cannot be reused on other cases.

* While the Ring Holder increases grip and reduces the risk of drops, please do not rely on it alone to carry your phone.

* Please note: Our ring holders are not magnetic and don’t support MagSafe or wireless charging.

descriptionHtml:

Step up your planning game with the Infinity Planner!

It's a planner, but not as you know it—undated, unpretentious, and totally under your control.

Wrapped in sleek vegan saffiano leather and secured with a sleek magnetic clasp, it's durable enough to handle coffee spills and life's little oops moments.

Inside, you'll find a world where dates don't dictate your schedule. You start when you want, how you want.

Need to mark your spot? Two ribbons are at your service—because one is never enough.

Flip to the back, and voilà: a yearly calendar sheet (hello, 2026) and a smart metal time tag to clip on and show time who's the boss. And for everything else? Slide it into the handy back pocket—no more crinkled notes or lost receipts!

Whether you're a dreamer, a doer, or a bit of both, the Infinity Planner is your stylish sidekick in a world that won't stand still.

Features:

  • Page size: A5 (148 x 210 mm/5.8 x 8.3 in).
  • 144 pages to plan it all!
  • 100 gsm ivory paper thick enough to protect against ink bleeding.
  • FSC-certified paper to preserve the natural ecosystem.
  • Silk-feel paper texture for pens to glide through smoothly.
  • Vegan faux leather front hardcover with unique stylish designs.
  • Black back cover with gold metallic logo.
  • Built-in back pocket to stash your extras.
  • Metallic time tag: get each month’s days sorted
  • Planners covers dimensions: 151 x 216 x 17 mm/5.9 x 8.5 x 0.7 in.
  • Superior flat-lay binding—no more battling with pages that won't stay put!
  • Secure magnetic flap to keep everything private.

Small but mighty. Stylish but practical. Meet the new and improved BURGA Magnetic Power Bank, your pocket-sized savior with a 5,000 / 10,000 / 15,000 mAh punch. It’s made to keep you charged and turning heads wherever you go.

With a strong N52 magnet, it locks onto MagSafe-compatible devices like it’s meant to be there, offering 7.5W wireless charging for iPhones 12 and up.

We’ve taken power to the next level, wrapped in overcharge and overheating protection, and backed by CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications, because safety never goes out of style.

Wireless charging is designed specifically for MagSafe-compatible iPhones, using Qi technology and delivering up to 7.5W. Some newer Android phones may support wireless charging, but they will not attach magnetically, and alignment is not guaranteed. For all other phones and full charging compatibility, use the included USB-C cable.

  • BURGA Power Banks are not CCC certified and may not be allowed through airport security checks in China.

FEATURES:

  • MagSafe-Compatible: Power Bank designed for wireless charging of MagSafe-compatible iPhones (12 and newer only). Wireless charging may work for some Android models, but the magnet will not attach. Use a USB-C cable for all non-MagSafe phones.

  • Dual Charging: Charge two devices at once, wirelessly and with a cable.
  • Compact and Durable: Slim design with a scratch-resistant finish and strong N52 magnet.
  • Safety First: Overcharge, over-current, and short-circuit protection with CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications.
  • Fast Recharge: Charge the power bank via a USB-C input port (60W-2V0/3A Type C to C cable included). Power indicator lights show remaining energy levels.
  • Unique Designs: Available in 300+ stunning, fade-proof prints.
  • Perfect Match: Designed to match BURGA’s accessory range, making it easy to mix and match for your style.

title: Academy - Adhesive Ring Holder
descriptionHtml:
Please note: Actual product colors may vary slightly due to materials, lighting, and screen differences.

Smartphones keep growing, but our hands? Not so much. It's a digital juggling act. And let's face it, a dropped phone is a heartbreak no case can fully cushion. So why risk a fumble when you can avoid it?

Meet the BURGA Phone Ring Holder: the tiny hero your phone didn't know it needed. Pop it on the back of your phone, loop a finger through, and voilà! — your tech stays in place, effortlessly. Now that's what we call hands-on security.

Bonus points:

  • You can use it as a stand.
  • Extra stylish & cute.
  • Ultra-strong 3M VHB adhesive pad.
  • No sticky residue after detaching.

* NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

* Optimized for smooth, hard-shelled cases. Does not stick to rubberized or textured materials.

* Designed for one-time use, offering strong support for your device. Once removed, our Ring Holders cannot be reused on other cases.

* While the Ring Holder increases grip and reduces the risk of drops, please do not rely on it alone to carry your phone.

* Please note: Our ring holders are not magnetic and don’t support MagSafe or wireless charging.

descriptionHtml:

The tumbler that says “I’ve got my life together”.
Even when you absolutely don’t.

This 40oz / 1.2L tumbler keeps your drink hot for 12 hours, cold all day, and your bag completely dry thanks to a leakproof straw lid that actually locks. It fits your car cup holder, has a handle that feels right, and comes in colors you’ll want to match your outfit with.

Whether it’s coffee, water, or a chaotic iced matcha with oat milk and a side of anxiety — this tumbler carries it, cleans up easy, and looks damn good doing it.

FEATURES:

  • 40oz / 1.2L Capacity: Holds more so you refill less.
  • Leakproof Straw Lid: Locks tight with zero spills. Flip it, toss it, commute with it. Your drink stays put.
  • Double-Wall Insulation: Keeps drinks hot for up to 12 hours and cold even longer. No lukewarm regrets.
  • Cup Holder Compatible: Slim base slides into most standard car cup holders.
  • Ergonomic Handle: Made to feel good in your hand. Comfy, balanced, easy to carry.
  • One-Hand Operation: Flip, sip, and go. Designed for multitasking and moving fast.
  • Materials: 304L Stainless Steel (Body & Straw), BPA-Free PP + Silicone (Lid), PP (Handle)
  • Care Instructions: Wash before first use. Hand wash the tumbler. Lid is top-rack dishwasher safe

title: Academy - Infinity Planner
descriptionHtml:
Please note: Actual product colors may vary slightly due to materials, lighting, and screen differences.

Step up your planning game with the Infinity Planner!

It's a planner, but not as you know it—undated, unpretentious, and totally under your control.

Wrapped in sleek vegan saffiano leather and secured with a sleek magnetic clasp, it's durable enough to handle coffee spills and life's little oops moments.

Inside, you'll find a world where dates don't dictate your schedule. You start when you want, how you want.

Need to mark your spot? Two ribbons are at your service—because one is never enough.

Flip to the back, and voilà: a yearly calendar sheet (hello, 2026) and a smart metal time tag to clip on and show time who's the boss. And for everything else? Slide it into the handy back pocket—no more crinkled notes or lost receipts!

Whether you're a dreamer, a doer, or a bit of both, the Infinity Planner is your stylish sidekick in a world that won't stand still.

Features:

  • Page size: A5 (148 x 210 mm/5.8 x 8.3 in).
  • 144 pages to plan it all!
  • 100 gsm ivory paper thick enough to protect against ink bleeding.
  • FSC-certified paper to preserve the natural ecosystem.
  • Silk-feel paper texture for pens to glide through smoothly.
  • Vegan faux leather front hardcover with unique stylish designs.
  • Black back cover with gold metallic logo.
  • Built-in back pocket to stash your extras.
  • Metallic time tag: get each month’s days sorted
  • Planners covers dimensions: 151 x 216 x 17 mm/5.9 x 8.5 x 0.7 in.
  • Superior flat-lay binding—no more battling with pages that won't stay put!
  • Secure magnetic flap to keep everything private.
  • 2 black ribbon page markers.
  • Product weight: 454 g/16.01 oz.
  • NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

Small but mighty. Stylish but practical. Meet the new and improved BURGA Magnetic Power Bank, your pocket-sized savior with a 5,000 / 10,000 / 15,000 mAh punch. It’s made to keep you charged and turning heads wherever you go.

With a strong N52 magnet, it locks onto MagSafe-compatible devices like it’s meant to be there, offering 7.5W wireless charging for iPhones 12 and up.

Fast-charge any device with PD20W USB-C cable.

We’ve taken power to the next level, wrapped in overcharge and overheating protection, and backed by CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications, because safety never goes out of style.

Important:

  • This power bank magnetically attaches only to iPhones 12 and newer. It will not stick to any other phone models. Wireless charging is designed specifically for MagSafe-compatible iPhones, using Qi technology and delivering up to 7.5W. Some newer Android phones may support wireless charging, but they will not attach magnetically, and alignment is not guaranteed. For all other phones and full charging compatibility, use the included USB-C cable.
  • Magnetic Power Banks do not charge devices up to 100% wirelessly. Expect up to 80% depending on your device model.
  • BURGA Power Banks are not CCC certified and may not be allowed through airport security checks in China.

FEATURES:

  • MagSafe-Compatible: Power Bank designed for wireless charging of MagSafe-compatible iPhones (12 and newer only). Wireless charging may work for some Android models, but the magnet will not attach. Use a USB-C cable for all non-MagSafe phones.
  • PD20W Fast Charging: PD20W USB-C wired charging for Android, Huawei, and Samsung via included USB-C cable.
  • Dual Charging: Charge two devices at once, wirelessly and with a cable.
  • Compact and Durable: Slim design with a scratch-resistant finish and strong N52 magnet.
  • Safety First: Overcharge, over-current, and short-circuit protection with CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications.
  • Fast Recharge: Charge the power bank via a USB-C input port (60W-2V0/3A Type C to C cable included). Power indicator lights show remaining energy levels.
  • Unique Designs: Available in 300+ stunning, fade-proof prints.
  • Perfect Match: Designed to match BURGA’s accessory range, making it easy to mix and match for your style.
  • Printed Surface: The design is printed, not embossed or textured.

title: Academy - Water Bottle
descriptionHtml:
Please note: Actual product colors may vary slightly due to materials, lighting, and screen differences.

Meet your new hydration hero: the BURGA water bottle. Keep your drinks at the perfect temperature and your style impeccable, whether at the gym, office, or outdoors.

Sizes:

  • 500 ml (16.9 oz.): H 25 cm (9.8 in.) x neck W 3.8 cm (1.5 in.) x bottom W 7.5cm (3 in.) 286g (10 oz.)
  • 800 ml (27 oz.): H 26.9 cm (10.6 in.) x neck W 3.8 cm (1.5 in.) x bottom W 8 cm (3.1 in.) / 345g (12.1 oz.)

Dive into a sea of choices with over 500 unique BURGA designs, each paired with one of three sleek stainless steel caps – gunmetal, rose gold, or silver. Our team meticulously matches the cap to the design, so you always get a bottle that’s effortlessly stylish.

Key Features:

  • Pure Taste: No bad yucky plasticky taste – just pure, fresh-tasting water.
  • Ease of Use: One-handed operation, easy to clean, and ice cube compatible.
  • Temperature Isolation:

    • 500 ml (16.9 oz.) water bottle: Keeps drinks hot for up to 24 hours, cold for up to 24 hours.

    • 800 ml (27 oz.) water bottle: Keeps drinks hot for up to 24 hours, cold for up to 24 hours.

  • Premium materials: BPA-free & lead-free stainless steel with triple-layer insulation.
  • Design: Soft-touch rubber grip on the cap and non-GMip rubber pad on the bottom for stability.
  • Leakproof: Toss it in your bag without a second thought.
  • Cup Holder Friendly: Fits most cup holders (excluding the 800 ml/ 27 oz. bottle).
  • NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

Care instructions:

Wash before first use.

To keep your BURGA water bottle looking fierce and functioning flawlessly, hand wash with mild detergent only. Avoid abrasive sponges or cleaners, and never, ever pop it in the dishwasher or microwave. Avoid prolonged soaking to preserve the print's vibrancy.

title: Achromatic - Adhesive Ring Holder
descriptionHtml:
Please note: Actual product colors may vary slightly due to materials, lighting, and screen differences.

Smartphones keep growing, but our hands? Not so much. It's a digital juggling act. And let's face it, a dropped phone is a heartbreak no case can fully cushion. So why risk a fumble when you can avoid it?

Meet the BURGA Phone Ring Holder: the tiny hero your phone didn't know it needed. Pop it on the back of your phone, loop a finger through, and voilà! — your tech stays in place, effortlessly. Now that's what we call hands-on security.

Bonus points:

  • You can use it as a stand.
  • Extra stylish & cute.
  • Ultra-strong 3M VHB adhesive pad.
  • No sticky residue after detaching.

* NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

* Optimized for smooth, hard-shelled cases. Does not stick to rubberized or textured materials.

* Designed for one-time use, offering strong support for your device. Once removed, our Ring Holders cannot be reused on other cases.

* While the Ring Holder increases grip and reduces the risk of drops, please do not rely on it alone to carry your phone.

* Please note: Our ring holders are not magnetic and don’t support MagSafe or wireless charging.

descriptionHtml:

Step up your planning game with the Infinity Planner!

It's a planner, but not as you know it—undated, unpretentious, and totally under your control.

Wrapped in sleek vegan saffiano leather and secured with a sleek magnetic clasp, it's durable enough to handle coffee spills and life's little oops moments.

Inside, you'll find a world where dates don't dictate your schedule. You start when you want, how you want.

Need to mark your spot? Two ribbons are at your service—because one is never enough.

Flip to the back, and voilà: a yearly calendar sheet (hello, 2026) and a smart metal time tag to clip on and show time who's the boss. And for everything else? Slide it into the handy back pocket—no more crinkled notes or lost receipts!

Whether you're a dreamer, a doer, or a bit of both, the Infinity Planner is your stylish sidekick in a world that won't stand still.

Features:

  • Page size: A5 (148 x 210 mm/5.8 x 8.3 in).
  • 144 pages to plan it all!
  • 100 gsm ivory paper thick enough to protect against ink bleeding.
  • FSC-certified paper to preserve the natural ecosystem.
  • Silk-feel paper texture for pens to glide through smoothly.
  • Vegan faux leather front hardcover with unique stylish designs.
  • Black back cover with gold metallic logo.
  • Built-in back pocket to stash your extras.

  • Planners covers dimensions: 151 x 216 x 17 mm/5.9 x 8.5 x 0.7 in.

Meet your new hydration hero: the BURGA water bottle. Keep your drinks at the perfect temperature and your style impeccable, whether at the gym, office, or outdoors.

Sizes:

descriptionHtml:

Smartphones keep growing, but our hands? Not so much. It's a digital juggling act. And let's face it, a dropped phone is a heartbreak no case can fully cushion. So why risk a fumble when you can avoid it?

Meet the BURGA Phone Ring Holder: the tiny hero your phone didn't know it needed. Pop it on the back of your phone, loop a finger through, and voilà! — your tech stays in place, effortlessly. Now that's what we call hands-on security.

Bonus points:

  • You can use it as a stand.
  • Extra stylish & cute.
  • Ultra-strong 3M VHB adhesive pad.
  • No sticky residue after detaching.

* NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

* Optimized for smooth, hard-shelled cases. Does not stick to rubberized or textured materials.

* Designed for one-time use, offering strong support for your device. Once removed, our Ring Holders cannot be reused on other cases.

* While the Ring Holder increases grip and reduces the risk of drops, please do not rely on it alone to carry your phone.

* Please note: Our ring holders are not magnetic and don’t support MagSafe or wireless charging.

title: Afternoon Nap - Infinity Planner
descriptionHtml:
Please note: Actual product colors may vary slightly due to materials, lighting, and screen differences.

Step up your planning game with the Infinity Planner!

It's a planner, but not as you know it—undated, unpretentious, and totally under your control.

Wrapped in sleek vegan saffiano leather and secured with a sleek magnetic clasp, it's durable enough to handle coffee spills and life's little oops moments.

Inside, you'll find a world where dates don't dictate your schedule. You start when you want, how you want.

Need to mark your spot? Two ribbons are at your service—because one is never enough.

Flip to the back, and voilà: a yearly calendar sheet (hello, 2026) and a smart metal time tag to clip on and show time who's the boss. And for everything else? Slide it into the handy back pocket—no more crinkled notes or lost receipts!

Whether you're a dreamer, a doer, or a bit of both, the Infinity Planner is your stylish sidekick in a world that won't stand still.

Features:

  • Page size: A5 (148 x 210 mm/5.8 x 8.3 in).
  • 144 pages to plan it all!
  • 100 gsm ivory paper thick enough to protect against ink bleeding.
  • FSC-certified paper to preserve the natural ecosystem.
  • Silk-feel paper texture for pens to glide through smoothly.
  • Vegan faux leather front hardcover with unique stylish designs.
  • Black back cover with gold metallic logo.
  • Built-in back pocket to stash your extras.
  • Metallic time tag: get each month’s days sorted
  • Planners covers dimensions: 151 x 216 x 17 mm/5.9 x 8.5 x 0.7 in.
  • Superior flat-lay binding—no more battling with pages that won't stay put!
  • Secure magnetic flap to keep everything private.
  • 2 black ribbon page markers.
  • Product weight: 454 g/16.01 oz.
  • NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

This design features: pastel stripes, pink stripes, blue stripes, soft spring colors

title: Afternoon Treat - Cherry Kindle Paperwhite (11th Gen) Case
descriptionHtml:
Please note: Actual product colors may vary slightly due to materials, lighting, and screen differences.

Stylish protection for your reading buddy. The BURGA Kindle Paperwhite 5 Case (2021, 11th Generation) is designed to protect your Kindle while enhancing your reading experience.

Crafted from premium vegan Saffiano leather with a soft microfiber interior, it keeps your device safe from scratches, dust, and fingerprints. The shock-absorbing TPU bumper shields your Kindle from unexpected drops—because accidents happen, even to the most careful book lovers. 

Tired of awkward grips and hand cramps? The elastic hand strap gives you a secure, one-handed hold, making long reading sessions effortless. Whether you're curled up in bed, lounging at a café, or traveling, this Kindle Paperwhite 11 case keeps your e-reader steady and comfortable.

The auto sleep/wake function saves battery life, while the magnetic closure keeps everything securely in place. And with a variety of fade-proof designs, your Kindle stays as fresh as the day you got it.

Features:

  • Perfect Fit: Designed exclusively for Kindle Paperwhite 5 (2021 release, 11th Gen) & Signature Edition. 
  • Auto Sleep/Wake Function: Magnetic cover preserves battery life.
  • Elastic Handle Grip: Secure hold for long reading sessions.
  • Shock Absorption: TPU wrap-around bumper provides enhanced drop protection.

title: Aftershock - Infinity Planner
descriptionHtml:

Step up your planning game with the Infinity Planner!

It's a planner, but not as you know it—undated, unpretentious, and totally under your control.

Wrapped in sleek vegan saffiano leather and secured with a sleek magnetic clasp, it's durable enough to handle coffee spills and life's little oops moments.

Inside, you'll find a world where dates don't dictate your schedule. You start when you want, how you want.

Need to mark your spot? Two ribbons are at your service—because one is never enough.

Flip to the back, and voilà: a yearly calendar sheet (hello, 2026) and a smart metal time tag to clip on and show time who's the boss. And for everything else? Slide it into the handy back pocket—no more crinkled notes or lost receipts!

Whether you're a dreamer, a doer, or a bit of both, the Infinity Planner is your stylish sidekick in a world that won't stand still.

Features:

  • Page size: A5 (148 x 210 mm/5.8 x 8.3 in).
  • 144 pages to plan it all!
  • 100 gsm ivory paper thick enough to protect against ink bleeding.
  • FSC-certified paper to preserve the natural ecosystem.
  • Silk-feel paper texture for pens to glide through smoothly.
  • Vegan faux leather front hardcover with unique stylish designs.
  • Black back cover with gold metallic logo.
  • Built-in back pocket to stash your extras.
  • Metallic time tag: get each month’s days sorted
  • Planners covers dimensions: 151 x 216 x 17 mm/5.9 x 8.5 x 0.7 in.
  • Superior flat-lay binding—no more battling with pages that won't stay put!
  • Secure magnetic flap to keep everything private.
  • 2 black ribbon page markers.
  • Product weight: 454 g/16.01 oz.
  • NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

descriptionHtml:

The newly enhanced 4D L-track massage is designed to massage wider, deeper, and more precisely than the conventional massage rollers. The 4D massage technology will mimic the hands of a professional masseur. The AmaMedic Hilux 4D offers 8 different levels of 4D intensity. With the variety of adjustment levels, such as 5 levels of air massage intensity and speed of the rollers.
The Hilux 4D will perform a body scan to map the key areas of the neck and back to ensure the optimal amount of pressure applied during the massage. The scanning technology will detect your shoulders height, which can be re-calibrated once the scan is complete.
The AmaMedic Hilux 4D has 8 automatic massage programs to choose from. Demo: This program will cycle through briefly all its different massages it has to offer. Relax: This program utilizes a softer massage to help bring the user into a more relax state where the massage is less aggressive. Swing: This program will massage the user while rocking in a back and forth movement to create a more calming state of mind and experience. Stretch: This program will inflate certain regions pinning you to the chair and then proceed to stretch out the body from your legs to your shoulder while getting massaged Scraping: This program perform a scraping style massage pressing in and releasing in a down and upward motion. This is great to stretch out muscles in isolated areas. Shiatsu: This program helps to perform a more pinpointed massage along the back. This massage style helps to focus on certain pressure points in the back targeting tense muscles. Gentle Relief: This program helps to performs a tapping action with tapping. Rejuvenate: This program utilizes the strong massage styles and aggressively massages the back.
The AmaMedic Hilux 4D has the most advanced back heating system with a mild infrared heat. The roller itself will heat up at the same time. The heated back roller allows for a far greater surface heating area, From the neck down to the hamstrings. It applies an infrared heat which is deep penetrating compared to traditional thermal heat with the high temperatures. The warm heat will compliment the massage in loosening the muscles.
The Hilux combines both the S and L track technology for an exceptional massage experience. The S-Track rollers will contour the natural curvature of your spine. The L-Track extends from your neck, all the way down past your lower back, and finally massaging underneath the back of your upper thighs. The L-Track offers about 50% more massage area than your average S-Track chairs.
There are multiple airbags located throughout the massage chair to offer a full body massage experience. The Hilux offers a total of 18 highly advanced airbags in the massage chair. Airbags are located at the shoulders, arms, waist and pelvis, and the calf areas. The total air bags have been reduced but covers more surface area than previous technology with far greater efficiency and reliability.
Regardless of body type the adjustable shoulder massager can be easily tightened by pushing the massagers inwards. There are 3 adjustable sizes on each side. To reset to the default width simply push in all the way on both sides and it will release.
Side panel controller is designed that the user can easily control the chair without using a remote tablet. The user can adjusting 4D intensity, reclining positions, Zero Gravity, Auto massage program and Heating function.
USB Charger & Wireless Charger AmaMedic Hilux 4D thoughtfully designed with a wireless charger for the modern times of digital devices. The user can charge their smartphone on the wireless charging pad located at the top of the armrest. Please not the wireless charger is only available with wireless charging capability.
Touch Screen Controller The AmaMedic Hilux 4D’s remote is upgraded to Touch Screen Remote Tablet. It has an easy view screen displaying the function of the chair. It also has magnetic holder that holds the remote into place. The interface is very easy to navigate and adjust settings.
Hilux is equipped with 2 stages of zero gravity, giving the user a weightless feeling during the massage. This gives the user an option on how far back they want their chair to recline automatically, or you can adjust the chair manually with the remote.

title: Atomic Alarm Clock with Projection Display
descriptionHtml:
VIDEO

FEATURES

For the easiest time checks to suit a fast-paced lifestyle - we present the Baldr atomic alarm clock with a built-in time projector. One glance at the ceiling or the wall is all you need. The built-in projector swivels at 180-degree angles and projects the time towards a wall or ceiling with a maximum distance of 11.4 feet. Time checks are quicker and easier than ever. You'll be surprised to discover how a simple advanced feature can make things so easy. This Baldr alarm clock is a smart home gadget with all the essential info you need in 1 LCD screen - featuring a calendar, digital thermometer for room temperature and outdoor temperature, 12-24 hour weather forecasting, an outdoor/indoor humidity monitor, and an atomic radio that ensures your clock is accurate to the last second. But don't be fooled by all Baldr's advanced features - it's a simple setup that automatically syncs and updates itself once you connect the outdoor transmitter to the indoor device.

  • MADE FOR QUICK TIME CHECKS: Check the time in your easiest and most convenient way on a Baldr clock/ outdoor and indoor thermometer for home with its powerful time projector featuring a 180-degree adjustable angle and a maximum reach of 11.4 feet.
  • SIMULTANEOUS INDOOR AND OUTDOOR TEMPERATURE MONITORING: The powerful wireless transmitter connects with the indoor receiver to feed it with outdoor weather data within a 12-24 hour timeframe; both indoor and outdoor temperature can be viewed on the screen
  • COMPLETE ESSENTIAL INFO: This smart device features more than a weather forecaster; it's a calendar, alarm clock, thermometer, and digital hygrometer in one; Clear graphics are displayed on a large colored LCD screen for easy reading
  • SIMPLE STRESS-FREE SETUP: The wireless indoor receiver is powered by an AC adaptor while the outdoor transmitter runs on 2 AA batteries. Once powered on, these 2 devices automatically sync and its atomic radio signal auto-updates the date and time.
  • ULTRA-SLIM AND SLEEK: The minimalist and modern design of the Baldr wireless room temperature monitor matches any home interior; Place on top of your console or corner table for an easy and convenient weather update any time of the day

 

Please Note:

After plugged in, the screen will go dim/dark while in WWVB atomic receiving mode. Meanwhile, the projection will automatically be off as well. Our clock searches for WWVB signals at initial setup & several times a day, each lasting up to 7 minutes with the antenna symbol flashing on the screen. After the search completes, the backlight brightness will come back on, and all functionalities, including the projection display, will resume. You may press & hold the "RCC" button to exit RCC receiving mode anytime.

descriptionHtml:
Stay on Time and Informed with Style!

The BALDR Atomic Alarm Clock features a large color digital display, showing time, indoor temperature, humidity levels, and real-time moon phases. Perfect for your desk, bedside table, or office, this clock combines functionality with modern design.

- Large Color Display: Easy-to-read digital time at a glance.

Keep track of time, monitor your indoor environment, and enjoy additional moon phase information with this smart atomic alarm clock.

FEATURES

Introducing BALDR's latest Atomic Alarm Clock, designed to enhance bedrooms and offices with its essential features. This color backlit clock not only displays the time, day, and temperature but also offers the convenience of an atomic RCC receiving function for effortless setup and continuous accuracy. With its crystal-clear and large display, you can easily read the explicit images day or night without any distractions that may hinder your sleep. Moreover, for those who closely follow the lunar cycle, the clock provides vivid images of moon phases, adding an extra touch of appreciation and fascination.

  • Ultra Easy Setup with Automatic Time Adjustment: Simplify the setup process with our atomic clock. By setting the time zone and leaving it plugged in overnight, the clock will automatically adjust the time and calendar date using the WWVB radio broadcast from the US National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). It also self-updates for daylight saving time (DST) in North America, ensuring accurate and hassle-free timekeeping.

  • Sharp Color LCD Display with Adjustable Brightness: Experience an easy reading day or night with our electric atomic clock's sharp color LCD display. The white backlit display with adjustable screen brightness allows you to comfortably view the time, date, day, indoor temperature, humidity, and real-time moon phases without causing disturbances during sleep. The large and vivid digits ensure clear visibility and readability.

  • Convenient Alarm with Snooze Function: Designed for bedroom use, our atomic time alarm clock includes a snooze button for those mornings when getting up is a challenge. It also serves as an excellent desk clock for offices, businesses, or homes, thanks to its electronic calendar function and superior indoor temperature readings. Enjoy the convenience and versatility of this digital atomic calendar clock in any setting.

  • Built-in Backup Battery for Uninterrupted Performance: Rest easy knowing that our self-setting digital clock comes with a built-in CR2032 cell battery. In the event of a power interruption, the clock will store your time and alarm settings, ensuring they remain intact once the power is restored. Additionally, a low battery warning will appear, indicating when it's time to replace the cell battery for your convenience.

  • Adjustable Backlight for Comfortable Usage: Our atomic self-setting clock offers adjustable backlight brightness options to suit your preferences. Choose from 100%, 50%, 3%, or completely turn it off to ensure the display is easy on your eyes. Whether you need a gentle glow or complete darkness, our premium-quality atomic clock with date and time provides the perfect solution.

 

Please Note:

During the initial setup and multiple times throughout the day, our clock enters WWVB atomic receiving mode, which can cause the screen to go dim or dark temporarily. During this mode, all buttons except for the "RCC" button will be non-responsive. The clock actively searches for WWVB signals, indicated by a flashing antenna symbol on the screen. This search process lasts for up to 7 minutes. Once the search is complete, the backlight brightness will return, and all functionalities will resume as usual. If desired, you can exit the RCC receiving mode at any time by pressing the "RCC" button.

descriptionHtml:

We've also included a removable storage tray that's slidable. No more having to remove the top tray to reach the cigars you want in the bottom.

  • DIGITAL ACCURACY - We've completely rebuilt the inside of our hygrometers, so they are the most accurate way to monitor the humidity inside your humidor, ensuring your cigars are fresh. Behind each hygrometer is a precise rubber gasket seal, giving you extra protection against unwanted air leakage.

  • MILITARY FOAM ACCESSORY DRAWER - Each Military Humidor drawer comes lined with EVA foam with a diamond-cut pattern that resembles the foam found in military storage cases. This patent-pending solution makes controlling your humidor's humidity between 65-72% RH a simple task. By recessing the Hydro System, we maximize how many cigars you can store. We recommend purchasing the Klaro membership to get a year's supply of the essentials to keep your humidor seasoned.

  • EVERYTHING YOU NEED - From the custom digital hygrometer, patent-pending Hydro System, removable/slidable wood storage tray, custom metal hardware, to the unique foam accessory drawer, every detail of this large humidor has been scrutinized to give you the best box for your cigars.

title: Calm Plus Flex Frame SL Track Massage Chair w/ Touchscreen Remote
descriptionHtml:
Indulging in relaxation after a long day is delightful, but sinking into the comfort of your own home and settling into a brand-new massage chair takes it to another level. Meet the Calm Plus by Fujiiryoki, a fusion of luxury and affordability. Loaded with premium features typically reserved for chairs twice its price, it promises a massage experience like no other.

Featuring a state-of-the-art 4D adjustable strength quad roller massage robot, the Calm Plus caters to every inch of your body, from neck to hips, thanks to its innovative flexible SL Track frame. Unlike conventional SL track chairs that confine you to a seated position, the flexible SL track allows you to recline fully flat, optimizing neck, shoulder, and stretch massages.

Operating the Calm Plus is a breeze with its user-friendly 5-inch touchscreen remote, while Bluetooth speakers provide soothing music to enhance your relaxation. And let's not forget the cozy heated blanket system, ensuring you stay comfortably warm throughout your massage session.

But the Calm Plus doesn't stop there. Its triple action calf massager combines Shiatsu roller, compression, and kneading airbags to invigorate your calves, promoting blood circulation and relieving tension. While most massage chairs rely solely on compression for calf massages, the Calm Plus offers a 3-way approach, delivering unparalleled comfort and rejuvenation.

And for your tired feet? Fear not. With foot rollers and airbags enveloping every inch, the Calm Plus pampers your feet with the care they deserve.

Design and Build:
  • Flex Frame SL Track: This chair uses a flexible SL (S-line + L-track) track system, which allows for a comprehensive massage from neck to hips, with the added benefit of reclining fully flat for enhanced upper back and neck massages.
  • Aesthetic Appeal: Features a modern, sleek design that would blend well in most home environments, available in multiple color options like charcoal, coffee, and taupe.
Massage Technology:
  • 4D Adjustable Strength Quad Roller: The massage robot adjusts in four dimensions, offering a massage experience that can be tailored in intensity and speed, mimicking the movements of human hands.
  • Air Compression: Utilizes 42 airbags for a full-body compression massage, targeting the shoulders, arms, pelvis, calves, and feet for enhanced relaxation and circulation.
Key Features:
  • Zero Gravity: Inspired by NASA technology, this feature allows the chair to recline into a position that reduces spinal pressure and enhances the effectiveness of the massage.
  • Heated Lumbar Blanket: Provides soothing warmth to your lower back, enhancing relaxation and muscle relief.
  • Triple Action Calf Massager: Combines Shiatsu roller, compression airbags, and kneading airbags for a comprehensive calf massage, promoting circulation and tension relief.
Control and Customization:
  • Touchscreen Remote: A user-friendly 5-inch touchscreen interface for easy control over the massage settings, including 12 auto programs, 7 massage techniques, and adjustable intensity.
  • Bluetooth Speakers: Allows streaming of music to complement your massage session, creating a more immersive relaxation environment.
Comfort and Ergonomics:
  • Full Body Stretch: The chair offers various stretching programs to relieve muscle tension and improve flexibility.
  • Reflexology Foot Massage: Equipped with foot rollers and airbags for a thorough foot massage that stimulates reflexology points.
User Experience:
  • Relaxation and Therapy: Users often commend the chair for its ability to provide both relaxation and therapeutic benefits, particularly for back pain relief and stress reduction.
  • Ease of Use: The touchscreen remote is noted for its intuitiveness, making it simple for users to customize their massage session.
Additional Considerations:
  • Space Saving: While it does require some space for reclining, the design considers space efficiency, making it suitable for various room sizes.
  • Health Benefits: The combination of heat, air compression, and varied massage techniques aims to offer more than just relaxation, potentially aiding in recovery from muscle strain or chronic pain.
Warranty:
  • Warranty: Comes with a 2-year manufacturer's warranty that includes in-home service, reflecting confidence in the chair's durability and performance.

title: Cyber Relax Elite Massage Chair by Synca Massage Chair
descriptionHtml:
Experience Japanese engineering at its finest with the Fujiiryoki Cyber Relax Elite, a luxury massage chair designed to deliver a deeply immersive and therapeutic massage experience from neck to glutes. At the heart of the Elite is Fujiiryoki’s advanced Flex Frame SL Track system, powered by a 4D massage robot equipped with silicone massage heads — soft and supple for comfort, yet firm enough to deliver precise, targeted pressure.

The Cyber Relax Elite stands out with its Triple Action Leg and Foot Massage system, which combines gripping calf rollers, kneading calf airbags, and full-leg compression to simulate a dynamic, therapeutic massage — far beyond the simple inflate-and-release action found in most chairs. The foot section features a partially enclosed design that envelops the feet for a more focused massage while still accommodating users with up to size 13 feet. Enjoy the powerful Triple Action Foot Rollers, and for a more intense experience, remove the included insoles to bring your feet into direct contact with the massage nodes.

This chair is also packed with the premium features expected in a high-end model, including:

  • Bluetooth premium sound system
  • LED accent lighting
  • Fingertip control panel

If you’re seeking a massage chair that blends elegant design with advanced functionality, the Fujiiryoki Cyber Relax Elite is your answer — offering a comprehensive, full-body massage that redefines luxury and relaxation.

title: Cyber Relax Ai - Executive Edition
descriptionHtml:
The Fujiiryoki Cyber Relax Ai Executive Edition is the result of over 70 years of expertise from master craftsmen, committed to delivering the ultimate massage experience. With cutting-edge AI technology, these expert engineers have developed a medical-grade massage system designed to melt away tension and target relief exactly where it's needed. The patented Fujiiryoki 5D massage technology demonstrates why this brand is the largest, oldest, and a leader in Japan's massage industry.

Effortlessly controlled via an 8-inch full-color touch panel, the Cyber Relax Ai is designed to accommodate users of various sizes, featuring a double leg rest extension for individuals up to 6'4"". Its special lay-flat frame enhances the upper back massage, while the arm massage system slides back with you, ensuring a perfect fit without your arms slipping out.

With customizable options, you can fine-tune the pressure of different air cells in 8 separate regions to your preference, and the 5D adjustable back massage ensures the perfect strength and settings for you. Once you find your ideal massage, it can be easily saved in the chair’s memory for future use.

Additionally, the Cyber Relax Ai offers premium features such as built-in DSP Premium speakers, allowing you to relax to your favorite music while enjoying a personalized, stress-relieving massage experience every time.

Manufacturing and Brand Background:
  • Made in Japan: Produced by Fujiiryoki, a company renowned for being the first to mass-produce massage chairs, highlighting its commitment to quality and innovation in the health equipment sector.
Design and Aesthetics:
  • Luxurious: The chair is designed to offer a sophisticated look that complements modern living spaces, with a focus on both functionality and style.
Massage Technology:
  • 5D AI Massage Robot: This chair utilizes an Artificial Intelligence algorithm to deliver a highly personalized massage. The AI adjusts the massage in real-time based on muscle tension, offering a sensation akin to a professional masseuse.
  • Real-Time Adjustment: The intensity and technique of the massage are dynamically altered to match the user's body needs, ensuring a stable and effective massage.
Key Features:
  • Massage Techniques: Offers an extensive suite of 86 different massage movements, providing a vast array of options from gentle to deep tissue massages.
  • Program Diversity: Includes 35 massage courses, with 23 automatic programs and 12 spot concentration techniques for precise targeting.
  • Body Scan Technology: Utilizes AI for body scanning, detecting the user's body shape, shoulder position, and spinal alignment for a tailored massage experience.
  • Heat Therapy: Features dual heating systems for the back and feet, promoting relaxation and improving circulation.
  • Foot Reflexology: Incorporates a Shiatsu foot roller with air compression for a comprehensive foot massage, with adjustable intensity levels.
Comfort and Ergonomics:
  • Zero Gravity: Enhances the massage by reclining the user into a position that minimizes spinal pressure.
  • Full Body Coverage: The massage extends from the neck down to the feet, ensuring no area is left unattended.
User Experience:
  • Voice Guidance: Assists users through the massage process with audio cues, making it more user-friendly.
  • High-Tech Interface: Comes with a 4.3-inch LCD touch panel for easy control over the massage settings.
Customization:
  • User Profiles: Allows saving personalized settings for multiple users, ensuring each session is tailored to individual preferences.
Warranty:
  • Warranty: Provides a comprehensive 5-year warranty covering in-home service, parts, and frame, reflecting confidence in its durability and performance.

title: Cyber Relax Pro - 4D Dual Massage Robot Flex Frame SL Track Massage
descriptionHtml:
The Fujiiryoki Cyber Relax Pro is the ultimate massage chair for anyone seeking a fully-loaded experience. It features dual massage robots that work simultaneously—one focusing on your back and the other on your glutes—for a deeply relaxing 4D massage. This technology is expertly hand-tuned by Fujiiryoki's engineers, who draw on more than 70 years of experience since the company pioneered massage chairs in 1954.

Immerse yourself in the premium air massage, which uses 86 airbags to cradle and massage your entire body, from head to toe. Even your neck benefits from a unique head pillow with embedded airbags that provide gentle kneading. The Cyber Relax Pro leaves nothing out, offering an automated leg rest extension that adjusts to taller users and a robotic shiatsu calf massager to ease tight calf muscles.

Controlling the chair is effortless with its 8-inch full-color touch panel, while the quadruple heat system with adjustable levels adds soothing warmth to your massage. For the ultimate relaxation, connect to the Bluetooth speakers and enjoy rich sound, powered by a subwoofer in the premium audio system. Place your phone on the wireless charger, make quick adjustments with the fingertip keys on the left, and simply unwind.

With every feature you could ever imagine in a massage chair, the Fujiiryoki Cyber Relax Pro sets the bar for luxury and innovation in massage technology. Look no further—this is the massage chair that has it all.

Design and Manufacturing:
  • Crafted for Luxury: Designed in Japan but manufactured in China, this chair maintains Fujiiryoki's commitment to quality and innovation.
  • Sleek Aesthetics: The chair comes in a modern design that's meant to blend into high-end home environments.
Massage Technology:
  • 4D Dual Massage Robot: Features two quad mechanisms, each with four kneading hands, providing a lifelike 4D massage experience. This means the massage can move in four dimensions - up, down, side-to-side, and in-out - to simulate human-like massage techniques.
  • 19 Massage Techniques: Offers an extensive range of massage styles, from kneading and tapping to combinations tailored for different parts of the body.
  • Flex Frame SL Track: The SL track combines the benefits of both S and L tracks, allowing for full-body coverage from the neck down to the glutes, with the flexibility to lay flat for a more comprehensive upper back massage.
Key Features:
  • Customization: Includes 20 pre-programmed massage programs, 5 adjustable speed levels, and 5 air pressure settings for a personalized experience.
  • Heat Therapy: Provides targeted heat to the neck, arms, legs, and lumbar region, enhancing muscle relaxation and circulation.
  • Air Compression: Utilizes 86 airbags for full-body compression massage, offering a deep sense of relaxation through air cell technology.
  • Biometric Fingertip Sensors: Allows for health monitoring by measuring heart rate, providing a health-conscious massage experience.
  • Intuitive Control: Features an advanced touch-screen control panel for ease of use and customization.
Comfort and Ergonomics:
  • Zero Gravity Recline: With just 4 inches of space required from the wall, the chair can recline into a zero-gravity position, reducing spinal pressure.
  • Extendable Footrest: Automatically adjusts to fit users of different heights, enhancing comfort.
  • Foot Massage: Includes dedicated rollers for foot reflexology, providing a thorough foot massage.
Audio and Connectivity:
  • Premium Sound System: Equipped with a sound system including an embedded subwoofer for an immersive audio experience during your massage.
Durability and Service:
  • Warranty: Fujiiryoki offers a comprehensive warranty, enhancing the value and reliability of your investment.
  • White-Glove Delivery: Available for an additional fee, ensuring careful setup and installation.
User Experience:
  • Users often commend the Cyber Relax Pro for its deep, customizable massage options, the comfort of its zero-gravity recline, and the luxury of its design. The dual 4D massage robots are particularly praised for providing a massage that feels like the work of human hands.

You can control the DCore 2 effortlessly with its intuitive touchscreen remote while streaming your favorite music through its discreet Bluetooth speakers. Fingertip controls allow easy adjustments on the fly, and you can relax and enjoy the triple-region heat system while in zero gravity. Experience the pinnacle of DCore engineering with the DCore 2.

Innovative Features:
  • Independent Hand Movement: The top two massage hands can move and massage independently, allowing for a more lifelike and customized massage experience.
  • Full-Body Compression: The chair includes a comprehensive compression system where airbags not only compress but also knead, providing a more dynamic massage.
  • Tornado-Shiatsu for Arms and Calves: Exclusive to D.Core, this feature uses oscillating rollers for an exceptional massage of the arms and calves.

title: Digital Time Projection Alarm Clock
descriptionHtml:
VIDEO

FEATURES

BALDR's newest Atomic Backlit Projection Clock, with temperature & comfort level is essential to bedrooms or offices. Not only does it have the regular features you would expect to see, such as time, day, and temperature, but it also projects the time & temp to ceiling or wall, with crystal clear image, for easy reading at night & day, without distractions at bedtime. You can also refer to the comfort level symbol that depicts how current conditions compare to ideal conditions, to decide if a humidifier or dehumidifier is needed.

  • CLEAR TIME PROJECTION ON ANY SURFACE- Our projection alarm clock features an ultra-clear and large time display; you can easily check the time with a glance without the trouble of lifting your head or checking your phone. The adjustable focus knob and 180-degree projector angle ensures a crisp and easy-to-read display. The projector can be turned on and off with a simple button switch, and the soft red projection is gentle on the eyes.

  • ATOMIC CLOCK FOR EASY SETUP – Just set the time zone and leave the clock plugged in overnight, our clock will automatically adjust time & calendar to atomic radio signal broadcast by NIST Radio Station WWVB Colorado, accurate to the second. It will also automatically update for daylight saving time. (Atomic feature only functions in North America, and normally works at midnight or in the very early hours of the morning).

  • LARGE CLEAR LCD DISPLAY – With warm orange backlit, and adjustable screen brightness, you can easily read the display, day or night, without being distracted when trying to sleep. Large digits on the back-lit LCD display the time, weekday, indoor temperature & humidity. Also features 3 comfort level reflecting the surrounding weather condition in your room, if it is too wet or dry.

  • ALARM WITH SNOOZE FUNCTION - No need to worry about those mornings when you just can't wake up, the snooze function will let you catch a little extra shuteye before alerting you again. The sound turns off but will automatically come on again after 5 minutes. This smart projection clock will wake you up comfortably and won’t let you oversleep!

  • TIME & TEMPERATURE PROJECTION – Perfect alarm clocks for bedrooms.  The projected time or temperature can be easily switched if you prefer one over the other.  Projection display can be dimmer or brighter and can be reversed by 180 degrees for optimal viewing and meet different user's preferences. A cell battery is included to backup all settings should a power outage occurs.

Please Note:

After plugged in, the screen will go dim/dark while in WWVB atomic receiving mode. Meanwhile, the projection will automatically be off as well. Our clock searches for WWVB signals at initial setup & several times a day, each lasts up to 7 minutes with the antenna symbol flashing on the screen. After the searching completes, the backlight brightness will come back on, and all functionalities, including projection display, will resume. You may press & hold the "RCC" button to exit RCC receiving mode anytime.

title: Light Theatre: Ambient Light With Stereo Speaker, Ripple Sunset Aurora
descriptionHtml:
What's Special About This 9-in-1 Ambient Light With Stereo Speaker

Inspired by the beauty of the natural world, Light Theatre radiates ambient glows that replicate natural wonders, like the magical aurora light, sparkling ripple & the flickering sunlight casting on the wall. Equipped with a down-firing subwoofer stereo speaker, it reproduces every sonic detail with breathtaking clarity. 

With 9 animated light themes and 3 light modes, you could effortlessly fine-tune the light to create a vibe that sets & matches your mood for the day. Trouble sleeping? Switch to a warm, calming light theme and play a soothing soundscape to create a relaxing vibe for sweet dreams. Having a party tonight? Switch on to the Rhythm mode or Gradient mode and have the light flashing, changing & dancing to the beat of music. Need a lamp? Use the lamp shade to convert the Light Theatre into a cute mushroom bedside lamp and adjust the remote control to dim the light. What's even better, you could dim the light under each theme or mix different themes to create new hues!

By combining stunning lights and brilliant sounds, Light Theatre creates an immersive show do delight your senses and set the vibes that match your mood. 

Best Practice 

For best performance, it is recommended to: 
1. Use Light Theatre under low light or dark conditions ( the darker the surroundings are, the brighter the glows become ) and you could use the 'bulb+' & 'bulb-' button to dim & adjust the brightness to the surroundings.
2. Place Light Theatre 1 meter away from the walls.
3. The down-firing subwoofer would perform much better when placing onto a rack

How It Works 

Below is a short manual of Light Theatre in case you lose physical one:

1. How to turn on / off the device: long-press the power button

2. How to connect to Bluetooth: turn on the Bluetooth on your device & search for 'CY-01' in the available device list 

3. What are the 9 light themes and how do they work? 

  • Warm Yellow light, animate the afternoon sunlight casting on the wall. Press 'Y' button on the remote control to activate 
  • White light, animate the stream. Press 'W' to activate
  • Yellow & white light, animate sparkling ripples. Press 'YW' to activate
  • Blue light, animate sunlight shone through the sea. Press 'B' to activate 
  • Blue & green light, animated aurora light. Press 'BG' to activate
  • Green, animate lake water. Press 'G'
  • Purple. Press 'P' 
  • Red. Press 'R'
  • Mix of green, red & yellow. Press 'K' button

4. How to adjust the light 

① How to switch between static light and dynamic light: press the 'gear' button on remote control to switch between dynamic and static light

② Use button '4' & '6' on remote control to dim the light

③ How to remix different light themes to create new hues: press 'YW' button then press button 'R', 'G', 'B', 'P', 'BG' or 'K' to remix and create new hues

5. What are the 3 play modes, and how do they work

① Rhythms mode

  • Effect: The light would flash to the beat of the music when playing the music. 
  • How to activate: only works when playing the music, press button '16' to activate
  • How to deactivate: press any color buttons 

② Jump mode

  • Effect: Flash & change colors when activated; When playing the music, the lights flash & change to the beat
  • How to activate: when music is off, press button '7'; When music is on, press button '16' to activate Rhythms mode first, then press button '7'
  • How to deactivate: when music is off, press any color button; When music is on, press any color button, then press button '16' 

③Gradient Mode

  • Effect: Gradually change colors when activated; when music is on, the light flickers while changing colors to the beat of the music.
  • How to activate: when music is off, press '8' to activate; when music is on, activate the Rhythms mode first by pressing button '16', then activate Gradient mode by pressing button '8'
  • How to deactivate: when music is off, press any color button; When music is on, press any color button then press button '16'

Whether you’re a baby or have a skin type that is sensitive to the chemical detergents, you can’t go wrong with the O3waterworks laundry system. Your skin will thank you.

SAVE MONEY 3 WAYS
The most obvious way you save money is by not ever having to buy detergent again. But you also don't have to heat your water, which most economists suggest costs more than the price of detergent (depending on your washing machine). The O3waterworks Laundry attachment is tough on dirt yet gentle on fabrics. The cold water and detergent-free cleaning help your clothes last longer and that saves you money.

NO PLUMBER or ELECTRICIAN NEEDED
Install the O3waterworks yourself with a simple pair of channel-lock pliers and Philips head screwdriver. If you can attach a garden hose, you can install the O3waterworks Laundry attachment.
