descriptionHtml:
Unwind and relax effortlessly with the Osaki Manhattan Duo— your personal oasis of tranquility at the touch of a button. With its highly advanced dual-track systems and AI technology, the Manhattan Duo can tailor the most optimal massage based on your body’s condition, offering an unprecedented experience you’ve never had before.
TECHNOLOGY The Osaki Manhattan Duo utilizes a built-in health sensor to gather data on your tension and stress, creating a customized massage program tailored to your needs.
4D + 3D DUAL MECHANISM TECHNOLOGY The Osaki Manhattan Duo uses dual mechanisms to target different body areas. The 4D system covers the back, while the 3D air system provides a consistent massage to the glutes and hamstrings.
Smart Body Scan System The Osaki Manhattan Duo features a smart body scan that adapts to your unique contours and dimensions, delivering a personalized massage just for you. 16 Auto Massage Programs & 7 Manual Massage Programs
Intelligent AI Health Monitor The Osaki Manhattan Duo features an advanced AI health sensor. When users hold the sensor on the left armrest, it detects metrics like heart rate, blood oxygen levels, microcirculation, HRV, and fatigue index. This AI delivers a personalized massage tailored to the user's body condition.
Intelligent Voice Control The Osaki Manhattan Duo is designed with intelligent voice control function, allowing users to operate the chair hands-free. Just begin a massage session by simply waking the chair with a command mentioned in the user manual.
Zero Gravity Reclining & Space Saving Technology Inspired by NASA, the Osaki Manhattan Duo provides Zero Gravity reclining. With Osaki’s Space Saving Technology, the user can place the massage chair 5.9 inches away from the wall and still achieve a complete recline.
SL-track Track System The Osaki Manhattan Duo is designed with SL which has a range that starts from the neck through the glutes to the top of the hamstrings. It delivers an incredibly consistent massage.
Quiet Massage Technology Equipped with the latest noise reduction technology, it provides a near-silent environment, enhancing the massage experience with complete tranquility and no distractions.
Auto Extension Footrest The legrest can be extended up to 10 inches (foot 7.5” + calf 2.5”) using the remote control, accommodating users of different heights up to 6'4" tall. 
26 Cell Full Air Body Massage Equipped with 26 airbags that are strategically positioned throughout the chair, it helps to provide a thorough and immersive compression therapy experience. 
Heating Therapy Utilizing carbon fiber, the Osaki Manhattan Duo offers targeted heating therapy to the lumbar, seat, and calf areas. This will enhance the massage experience, by helping to ease any muscle tension in those areas. 
Thinner 7’’ Touchscreen Controller Different than the previous models, the touchscreen controller for Manhattan Duo is thinner and easier to navigate. The sleek design also adds a touch of modern. 
Deep Calf Kneading The Manhattan Duo uses 8 airbags in the calf rest to deliver a comprehensive calf massage, providing a uniquely soothing experience. 
Foot Rollers & Kneading The Manhattan Duo combines memory foam and rollers to gently target the sides and tops of your feet, as well as your Achilles tendon, delivering soothing relief where you need it most. 
Wireless Charger & USB Port The Manhattan Duo features a wireless charger and USB port, allowing users to recharge devices while enjoying a relaxing massage. 
Largest Prevent-Trapped Sensor If a foreign object is detected near the footrest, the Manhattan Duo's touchscreen displays a warning. After inspecting and clearing the area, press ‘Clear’ to resume your massage. 
Luxurious Wood Grain Pattern on Armrest Unlike most chairs on the market, the Manhattan Duo prioritizes design and uses premium materials. The wood grain armrests provide a unique and elegant visual experience. 
Quick Side Control Panel The quick side control panels are conveniently placed on the armrests of Manhattan Duo, making it convenient and easy for users to quickly adjust their massage. 
Bluetooth HS Surround Speakers Connect via Bluetooth to your smartphone device and listen to any music or audio during a massage session. 
Hand Reflexology Massage The quick side control panels are conveniently placed on the armrests of Manhattan Duo, making it convenient and easy for users to quickly adjust their massage. 
Removable Pillow The Osaki Manhattan Duo offers the option of removing the headrest, allowing the user to experience even a deeper massage. 
LED Lighting With 7 LED color options and 1 changing rainbow LED light on each side, the Manhattan Duo helps to create an atmosphere of relaxation.

title: Osaki LK-219 Spa Capsule
descriptionHtml:
Osaki is breaking new ground with its innovative introduction to the at-home sauna market. The LK-219 Spa Capsule was designed to provide all of the benefits of traditional saunas with modern luxuries in mind. Listen to your favorite music, use your mobile device, and stretch your legs all while rejuvenating your skin and remaining health-conscious.

Luxury Sauna
The Osaki Spa Capsule provides all of the major benefits of its competitors: such as treating acne, hydrating skin, removing toxins, and providing relaxing chromotherapy. Its sleek design and hydraulic lid allow the capsule to fit in anywhere without taking up a cumbersome amount of space.

Intuitive Controls
The Spa Capsule’s intuitive control panel allows you to easily and effectively individualize your experience. Control the temperature, timer, music, and volume by cycling through the available options. Additionally, you can choose to toggle various treatments, like the steam, chromotherapy, and ozone modes on or off with a single click.

User Mobility
Most other at-home saunas lock you into place, restricting the use of your hands; but not the Osaki Spa Capsule! The top of the capsule includes two hand hole covers, which can easily be removed by applying slight pressure from the inside of the capsule. This innovative change allows for the user to customize their experience mid-treatment, use their phone, or even release a small amount of excess steam.

Adjustable Seat
Everybody is different, and every body is different too! With this in mind, Osaki has designed an adjustable seat to fit all body types. The seat can be raised and lowered nine inches to ensure anyone can sit comfortably.

Extendable Showerhead
Cleaning up should never be a hassle; therefore, Osaki has designed an extendable showerhead for easy and convenient maintenance of the device.

Speakers
The Capsule includes two high-fidelity speakers on either side of the user for a true surround sound experience. Connect your device via USB to listen to your own music or relaxing sounds while indulging in a genuine spa experience.

Spacious Design
You’ll never feel cramped within the Osaki Spa Capsule. Designed to provide the maximum space for all users, the capsule allows for a staggering thirty inches of legroom inside. Even individuals up to 6’6” can comfortably relax inside the Spa Capsule without issue.

Steam Machine
To improve the steam output, Osaki has developed one of the most efficient steam generators on the market. This 1.05 gallon / 4 liter removable tank can provide an effective steam bath for up to 90 minutes. The benefit of using an external steam generator, means that your Spa Capsule doesn’t need to be hard wired into a water line to operate- you can place and use your spa capsule wherever you’d like!

Health Benefits
At home saunas have a variety of incredible benefits such as: aiding with anti-aging techniques; removing harmful toxins from the skin; rejuvenating the skin and muscles after strenuous workouts; and even hydrating dry skin. What’s Included?
When you buy your Osaki Spa Capsule, you’ll receive the capsule itself, a one gallon steam generator, one removable foot massager, and two water basins!

Included:
- Spa Capsule
- One gallon steam generator
- Removable foot massager
- Two water basins

descriptionHtml:

This new revolutionary massage chair provides advanced features such as a thorough shoulder massage, muscle tension detection, and zero gravity positionings, which can be utilized with the Osaki Premium Master app or a call to Alexa.
Thorough Shoulder Massage The Osaki Master 4D+ proudly introduces the first ever over the shoulder massage using airbag compression that rotates and moves like real hands. There are a total of 10 individual airbags that synchronize to deliver a soothing massage.
Shoulder Massage Nodes There is an extra massage node on each side of the shoulder pad to emulate an element of a hand massage on your shoulders.

Muscle Tension Detection The Osaki Master 4D+ utilizes its perceptive health pro program to detect any tension in your torso area. Using AI technology, the chair will tailor a massage program to your specific needs since every user has its own needs and body types.

Made up of Laser-Crafted Steel, the SL-track allows the massage rollers to freely reach the entirety of your body. The SL-Track extends all the way from your neck and shoulders to your hamstrings.
Negative Oxygen Ions The Osaki Master 4D+ is incorporated with built-in negative air ionization therapy. According to research, negative air ionization therapy helps relieve stress and improve energy.
Zero Gravity Reclining and Space Saving With the Osaki Master 4D+’s one stage zero gravity reclining, encounter relaxation in a state of weightlessness. This essential technology was originally developed by NASA. Osaki’s Space Saving Technology allows for the chair to be placed 3 inches from the wall and still achieve a full recline.
Lumbar & Feet Heating The Osaki Master 4D+’s lumbar and feet heating system takes advantage of its heating coils to effectively warm and alleviates soreness along the lower back and feet.

title: Osaki OS-Maxim 3D LE Massage Chair
descriptionHtml:
Osaki Maxim Limited Edition.
Osaki’s best-selling massage chair is back and better than ever in the reimagined Maxim Limited Edition. The Maxim LE’s updated design brings a new splash of modernity into the classic Maxim design. Additionally, the upgraded three dimensional massage, zero gravity reclining, automatically extending footrest, and lumbar heating guarantees the highest quality massage every single time!

3D Massage Mechanism
The Maxim LE includes an industry-leading Three Dimensional Massage mechanism. This advanced massage system allows for a comprehensive intelligent massage to soothe stress along your shoulders, spine, lumbar, and glutes.
In order to encompass the entirety of your body, the Maxim includes a sturdy Steel SL-Track Frame. This track extends from your neck and shoulders to your thighs and glutes and acts as a guide for the 3D massage rollers.

Zero Gravity Reclining 
Weightless relaxation is now tenable with the Maxim LE, simply activate the Zero Gravity function to make use of this NASA-inspired technology. By positioning your legs at a higher elevation, you can negate the traditional strain of gravity on your body.

Space Saving Technology
By simultaneously sliding the Maxim forward while reclining, the chair is able to achieve a full zero gravity recline while only needing two inches between itself and the wall.

38 Cell Full Body Air Massage
The Maxim’s 38 Air Cells provide truly comprehensive full body compression therapy from top to bottom. With airbags along the shoulders, arms, hips, calves, and even feet!

Lumbar Heating
Relieve all unwanted tension in your lower back with the Maxim’s lumbar heat therapy. This calming heat allows for improved circulation, reduction of aches and pains, and soothing of overwhelming tension.

8 Auto Massage Modes 

  • Gentle: This calmingly soft massage is great for slow & gentle relaxation.
  • Relax: Use this massage mode for general relaxation across the entire body.
  • Therapy: After a long day at work, this program targets back pain with precision.
  • Vigorous: Use this program to work out knots and pain with speed and force.
  • Demo: This general massage works as a great entry point, covering most massage styles.
  • Swedish: Use this program for an intense contemporary take on a traditional Swedish Massage.
  • Thai: This recreation of the world-famous Thai massage uses strength and power to relax.
  • Chinese: This program makes heavy use of compression therapy and slower techniques.

6 Manual Massage Styles

  • Kneading: Deep, rhythmic, and thorough rocking motions.
  • Tapping: Quick, precise, and effective pointed motions.
  • Swedish: Rough, varying, and intense kneading motions.
  • Shiatsu: Sound, acute, and intentional compressing motions.
  • Clapping: Fast, broad, and wide patting motions.
  • Rolling: Slow, general, and long stroking motions.

The Maxim LE’s Powerful Foot Rollers are designed to target stress and tension in your feet with remarkable precision. These scientifically-designed acupuncture-enabled foot rollers were integrated to soothe after a day on your feet.

When initiating the massage, the Automatically Extending Legrest intelligently expands outwards and begins to retract in order to position itself comfortably for virtually any user.

No massage is complete in silence; therefore, the Maxim incorporates dual Bluetooth Speakers with mild Chromotherapy for high-fidelity surround sound audio.

title: Osaki Pro 4D Soho II Massage Chair
descriptionHtml:
Say hello to the new Soho II! This luxurious 4D Massage Chair builds upon the innovations of its predecessor while still providing maximum comfort at an affordable price. When you sit down in your Soho II you’ll be greeted with lumbar heating, an intensive full body air massage, a uniquely designed J-track system, a focused foot massage, and NASA-inspired zero gravity reclining. Whether you’re a massage chair aficionado, or looking to buy for the first time, Osaki’s Soho II will not disappoint. The Osaki Soho II has a clean simple design packed with the latest technology and innovation.

4D Massage Chair
The Soho II offers a highly customizable massage, with five degrees of speed, three varying widths, five levels of massage intensity, and five distinct air pressure intensities. The 4D massage heads move, vertically, horizontally, in and out and rotates at variable speeds. This chair offers one of the most life-like massages in the market.

Body Scan Technology
As you initiate your massage, the Soho II will begin automatically measuring your body to administer the perfect massage; additionally, key points of the body are mapped and remembered so that every massage is individually personalized.

Extendable Footrest
Regardless of your height, everyone deserves a comfortable massage, as such, the Soho II comes equipped with an extendable footrest reaching upwards of eight inches.

Heating
Dealing with muscle tension and back pain? The Soho II’s heated massage functions work to soothe mild pain in the lumbar and calves by releasing muscle tension and promoting healthier blood flow.

Foot roller
The Soho II’s unique foot massage is unlike any other on the market, its specialized rollers pay special attention to the sole of your foot. By naturally following the contour of the foot, the Soho II both rolls and scrapes your foot with extra care and deliberation.

Full Body Air Massage
Some massage chairs are just rigid shells for the underlying massage rollers, not the Soho II, however. This dynamic chair cradles and compresses every inch of you with its full body air massage, from your shoulders and arms to your calves and feet.

Zero Gravity
Osaki’s engineers have started utilizing technology originally developed by NASA to provide weightless relaxation. The Soho II incorporates two stage zero gravity reclining to position your body in such a way that you experience virtually weightless suspension.

Space Saving Design
Too much stuff? Not enough space? No worries! The Soho’s space saving design requires a mere 3.15 inches from the wall in order to achieve a full recline. This allows your chair to fit in even the tightest of spaces with no loss of functionality.

Bluetooth Speakers
Connect your mobile device via bluetooth to enjoy relaxing sounds, music, or even podcasts through the Soho’s dual surround sound speakers.

6 Automatic Programs
Neck/Shoulder: This auto program takes a heavy focus on your upper body, providing a deep and thorough massage along your shoulders and neck.
Strengthen: Use this program for a great general massage, broadly focusing on all parts of the body for maximum comfort.
Relax: This gentle massage is well-suited for individuals with tender areas, looking for a quick refresh after a stressful day.
Thai: The Thai massage is fantastic for those wanting a strong and intense massage, broadly focusing on the back and lumbar.
Recover: The recover mode can be utilized after intense physical work, loosening muscles and promoting increased blood flow across the board.
Sleeping: Finally, this gentle massage should be used before you go to bed, routine use will condition your body for long restful nights.

5 Massage Styles
Osaki’s Soho II provides a plethora of unique massage techniques to help anyone and everyone. These styles include, kneading, tapping, clapping, rolling, shiatsu, and finally, Swedish. Try each one for yourself and manually select the mode that works best for you!

descriptionHtml:
VIDEO

DESCRIPION

This RAINPOINT 2-zone water timer allows independent control of two garden areas. Featuring programmable schedules, rain delay, and manual watering, it is ideal for lawns, gardens, flower beds, and drip irrigation systems, helping save water while maintaining healthy plants.

FEATURES

The RAINPOINT sprinkler timer offers advanced features with 2 separate programmable zones, allowing you to customize watering schedules for each area of your yard. It provides 38 automatic watering frequencies with flexible duration and frequency options, ensuring your lawn is watered efficiently, even when you're away. The timer also includes 3 manual watering modes for quick and easy adjustments and a rain delay function to skip watering for 24, 48, or 72 hours during rainy days. The 2024 upgraded model features a 360° rotatable interface, a durable design with a self-cleaning valve diaphragm, and a low-battery warning with an easy-to-read LED display, ensuring reliable and long-lasting performance.

  • 2 Programmable Zones: The RAINPOINT sprinkler timer features two large outlets with a flow rate of 5-35 L/min, allowing you to customize the watering schedule—including start time, frequency, and duration—for each zone. This gives you complete control over watering different areas of your yard and lawn, ensuring even, efficient, and effortless irrigation.
  • 38 Automatic Watering Frequencies: This outdoor sprinkler timer offers a wide range of customizable watering durations (from 1 minute to 3 hours and 59 minutes) and frequencies (from every 1-12 hours or 1-7 days). You can create flexible watering plans, whether it's hourly, daily, cyclic, or fixed-time watering, giving you peace of mind while you're away on vacation.
  • 3 Manual Watering Modes: This sprinkler timer offers three separate manual modes, allowing you to easily switch between Zone 1, Zone 2, or both zones using the "Zone" button. You can set the manual watering duration from 1 to 59 minutes. This straightforward and effective feature provides quick and easy watering whenever and wherever necessary.
  • 24H/48H/72H Rain Delay: This hose timer includes a rain-delay function that allows you to pause watering for 24, 48, or 72 hours without disrupting your set schedule, helping to prevent over-watering and conserve water on rainy days. With auto, manual, and rain delay modes, this timer can meet all your watering needs.
  • 2024 Upgraded Hose Timer: This hose timer features a 360° rotatable interface for easy installation, along with a built-in metal filter capable of withstanding up to 35kg of water pressure. The second-generation valve diaphragm incorporates self-cleaning technology, providing a lifespan of up to 600,000 cycles. Constructed with IP54 high-impact plastic and heavy-duty materials, this timer is built for durability. Additionally, a seal ring has been added to the battery cover to prevent water leaks.
  • Low-Battery Warning: The water faucet timer is equipped with a 2.5" easy-to-read LED display that shows watering time, upcoming irrigation schedules, power levels, and other detailed information. If the battery needs to be replaced, a low-battery indicator will alert you, and the valve will automatically close to prevent any issues.

title: Square Up Challenge Puzzle Game
descriptionHtml:
This musical and amusing toy will give your kids hours of fun and will enhance their focus and small motor skills!

Get more to challenge your kids and their friends with this multiplayer toy...Choose 1 of 6 challenge Game Modes and master the moves to beat the blocks! Colored lights will show up, indicating which colors to match. Flip the side blocks to find the right colors. Slide the blocks into place and match!

You will be so happy to see them laughing together getting pure entertainment! They will love this toy and reach for it again and again...You can join the challenge too and Square up with them!

DETAILS:

  • Kids ages 8 and up can play this under the supervision of adults.
  • Measures 4 inches Wide.
  • Contents: 1x Game,2x AA Batt. and 1x Instruction Manual.
  • 6 Game Modes: Multiplayer Mode to challenge your friends, Level Mode lets you level-up to win!, Memory Mode is to remember the sequence, Speed Mode lets you beat the clock, Super Speed Mode it is you against the game computer and Super Level Mode once you play this level you need to remain this level only champions reach this level.
  • Get more and take it anywhere, play it anytime, It's addictive fun for anyone! Each sold separately.

INSTRUCTIONS:

1) POWER BUTTON: Press the power button to power up the unit.
Press and hold for 3 seconds to power Off the unit, the unit will automatically turn Off if left alone for 20 seconds at any time.

2) FLIP either side blocks to scroll through the different game modes.

3) MATCH the colored blocks to the lights.

4) SLIDE either side blocks around a corner to select a Game mode.

5) TO RESET all high scores, ensure the unit is Off, then hold the Power Button down for 10 seconds until you hear the word 'Zero'.

6) To adjust the volume, flip either side block until the 'VOLUME' mode appears(white color light). SLIDE either block around a corner to select, then FLIP a side block to scroll through the four-volume options: Silent, Quiet, Medium and Loud. To select the required volume, SLIDE a block around the corner again. The unit will then return to Mode Selection.

title: Titan Pro Cascade 3D Massage Chair
descriptionHtml:
The Titan Cascade 3D is the latest edition to Titan’s ever-growing roster of high-quality chairs. This sleek modern chair comes available in three colors (taupe, brown, and black), and includes a number of luxurious features. From an automated body scan and 6 automatic massages, to voice control and fatigue detection, the Cascade has it all! Treat yourself to a life of luxury with the brand-new Titan Cascade 3D.
 Voice Control The Cascade includes intelligent voice recognition, allowing the user to control the chair through 17 different voice commands. To initiate Voice Control, simply say "Hi Alice" or "Hey Alice”.
 Fatigue Detection The Cascade comes equipped with an automated health detection feature to detect your heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, and fatigue index.
 3D Massage Mechanism The Titan Cascade 3D comes equipped with 5 levels of 3D Massage Roller Adjustment in addition to Massage Range & Width. The 3D technology allows you to control the overall intensity of the massage by managing the depth of the back rollers. Unlike most 3D Massage chairs on the market, the Cascade lets you adjust the 3D roller depth at any point in the massage, whether you're in an auto mode or a manual mode. On top of the depth adjustment, there are 5 levels of speed, area and width adjustment available, and 5 levels of back massage intensity.
 Automatic Body Scan The Cascade is designed with the function of automatic body detection and micro-adjustment of shoulder position. By automatically detecting the curve of your spine and specific body measurements, the chair makes every massage more humanized and scientific. The Titan Cascade 3D will perform a body scan to map the key areas of the neck and back to ensure the optimal amount of pressure applied during the massage. The scanning technology will detect your shoulders height, which can be re-calibrated once the scan is complete.
 SL-Track Massage Additionally, the Cascade comes standard with Titan's latest massage rolling track, which massages from your neck, all the way down to your glutes and upper hamstrings. This is called an "SL" rolling track, and it works with the automated body scan at the beginning of every session to give every user a massage that fits their body.
 30 Air Cell Full Body Air Massage The Cascade is designed with efficiency in mind, and that includes the entire airbag system in the chair. The Titan Cascade 3D offers a total of 30 air cells and 5 levels for adjustment in the massage chair. The stream-lined design uses less air cells, while still giving a full-body air compression massage, therefore increasing the longevity and reliability of the chair.
 2 Steps Zero Gravity The Titan Cascade 3D is equipped with 2 steps of Zero Gravity, giving the user a weightless feeling during the massage. This gives the user an option on how far back they want their chair to recline automatically, or you can adjust the chair manually with the remote.
 Space Saving Technology To maximize living space in your home, the Cascade slides forward while reclining to create more space between the wall and the chair, requiring only 2.5 inches between the two.
 6 Auto ProgramsThe Titan Cascade 3D offers 6 different special auto massage programs which offer diverse massage experiences to the user.- Comfortable Massage: The most comfortable massage experience.- Relax Massage: A gentle and comfortable deep massage, which can relieve body fatigue and relax the body. - Neck & Shoulder Massage: The unique neck and shoulder massage program provides an effective massage of the cervical spine and scapula. Through routine use, neck and shoulder pain can be relieved and neck and shoulder fatigue can be improved.- Stretch Massage: The legrest and the backrest expand and contract for stretching of the calves and waist, effectively relieving tiredness, joint soreness, and restoring vitality.- Back & Waist Massage: A targeted massage focused on relieving back and waist soreness.- Full Body Massage: A deep and comprehensive massage, which can revive body vitality.
 11 Massage Styles 11 Massage Techniques are available including kneading (7 modes of Kneading can be cyclically switched), Tapping (Tapping I, Tapping II), Simultaneous Kneading and Tapping, Shiatsu (Shiatsu I, Shiatsu II), Grab, 3D (3D I, 3D II, 3D III, 3D IV), etc.
 Back and Calf Infrared Heat The Cascade has heating pads located on the back and calf areas. It offers heat therapy, a great compliment to the roller and airbag massage. Heating the body's temperature is known to increase blood circulation and loosen tense muscles.
 Bluetooth Speakers The Titan Cascade 3D is equipped with Bluetooth technology that reduces the surrounding noise, enhancing your listening experience.
Armrest Shortcut Panel The side shortcut controller is designed so that the user can easily control the chair without using a remote controller.

title: Titan Vibe 3D Massage Chair
descriptionHtml:
The Vibe 3D Massage Chair is a high-tech relaxation device designed to deliver a full-body, relaxing massage experience. Equipped with advanced 3D massage technology, it offers deep tissue relief by adjusting the intensity and angle of the rollers to target specific muscle groups. The chair features multiple massage modes, deep calf-kneading massage, and automatic body scan, creating a spa-like experience at home.
3D MASSAGE MECHANISM 
The Vibe is equipped with the latest generation robotic 3D massage system. This advanced technology enables the massage heads to move up, down, side to side, and in and out from the backrest, allowing for precise targeting of key areas along the back. 
AUTOMATIC BODY SCAN 
The automatic body scan tailors the massage to each user by detecting their unique shape and size, ensuring optimal comfort and effectiveness. 
DEEP CALF-KNEADING 
The deep calf kneading feature in the Osaki Vibe uses moving calf rest to relieve calf tension, improve circulation, and aid muscle recovery. 
SPACE-SAVING TECHNOLOGY 
The space-saving technology maximizes room efficiency by allowing the chair to glide forward as it reclines, enabling full recline functionality with only 6 inches of clearance from the wall. 
3-STAGE ZERO GRAVITY 
Inspired by NASA, the Osaki Vibe incorporates Zero Gravity, which elevates your legs to heart level. This posture promotes even weight distribution, alleviates pressure on the back, and enhances circulation in the legs. It also ensures uniform pressure from the massage rollers, delivering a balanced and consistent massage from the shoulders to the lower back. 
SL-TRACK SYSTEM 
Constructed out of from Laser-Crafted Steel, the Osaki Vibe’s SL-track Technology enables massage rollers to move seamlessly from your head to your hamstrings, providing a comprehensive full-body massage. 
24 AUTO PROGRAMS 

DEMO / THAI STRETCH / BODY CIRCULATION / RELAX / MORNING CARE / NIGHT CARE / DEEP TISSUE / MIDDAY CARE / RECOVERY / VITALITY / GENTLE / SHIATSU / OFFICE RELIEF / SPORTS RECOVERY / FOOT CARE / REJUVENATE / NECK MASSAGE / NECK & SHOULDER MASSAGE / BACK MASSAGE / LUMBAR MASSAGE / WAIST & HIP MASSAGE / LEGS MASSAGE / UPPER BODY / LOWER BODY
6 MANUAL PROGRAMS 
KNEADING / PERCUSSION / ACUPRESSURE / FLAP / SLAP / MIXTURE
32-CELL FULL BODY AIR MASSAGE 
The Osaki Vibe features 32 strategically placed air cells throughout the chair, providing a full-body massage that aids in promoting better blood circulation. 
3 SPECIALIZED FOOT ROLLERS 
Three-foot rollers are positioned at the base of the footrest, rotating to stimulate key areas of the feet with nodes that mimic the sensation of thumbs pressing into the balls, arch, and heel. These rollers help stretch muscles and connective tissues while targeting essential reflexology acupuncture points, enhancing circulation and providing relief. 
AUTOMATIC EXTENDABLE FOOTREST 
The footrest of Osaki Vibe can stretch up to 6 inches, making it fitting for users of various heights. The built-in body scan detects the user's leg length and automatically adjusts the footrest extension to ensure an ideal fit. 
LUMBAR AND FEET HEAT THERAPY 
Infrared heat pads in the lumbar and feet areas provide gentle warmth to enhance the massage's effectiveness by relaxing muscle tissue. This allows the air compression in the legs and back rollers to work more efficiently and promotes better circulation. Heat control is easily managed with the remote. 
HAND REFLEXOLOGY 
The Osaki Vibe includes mini nodes in the armrests for hand reflexology, aimed at relieving arm fatigue and enhancing blood circulation. 
TOUCHSCREEN CONTROLLER 
The touchscreen controller allows for easy access to select massage programs and adjust settings conveniently. 
REMOVABLE HEADREST 
Taking off the headrest of the Osaki Vibe enables users to enjoy a more optimal and deeper massage for their neck and upper shoulder areas. 
WIRELESS CHARGING SURFACE 
With the Osaki Vibe’s wireless charging surface feature, the user can conveniently charge their devices while enjoying a relaxing massage experience. 
BUILT-IN BLUETOOTH SPEAKERS 
Connect a smartphone to the Osaki Vibe’s dual high-quality Bluetooth speakers to enjoy your favorite audio during a massage session. 
CONVENIENT SHORTCUT PANELS 
The Osaki Vibe features conveniently positioned shortcut panels on the side of the chair, providing users with easy access to adjust settings with just a simple touch. 
LED LIGHTING DETAIL 
The Osaki Vibe adds ambiance with soft LED lights, creating a calming atmosphere that enhances relaxation during the massage.

title: Trigger Point Rocker - Posture Corrector
descriptionHtml:
The Trigger Point Rocker (TPR) is a patent-pending device that combines the hands-on clinical experience of Dr. Aaron Fu, DPT, with the science behind myofascial trigger points to help relieve neck, shoulder and lower back pain. The TPR was designed to help individuals relieve their frequent aches and pains from the comfort of their own home. Each product is also engraved with a QR code that gives users access to an online archive of different exercises and stretches that can be performed on the TPR to encourage users to take their wellbeing into their own hands. "It's nirvana for your back."

Relief In 5-10 Minutes
Relieve your neck, shoulder and back pain in just 5-10 minutes a day. Plus use our curated exercise library to build muscle fast.

Lay On It Or Sit With It
Based on the neutral spine position - the most stress-free position for your back - you can use it while on floor, or to keep your sitting posture in check.

Stay Fit + Healthy
Relieve muscle soreness for longer workouts & address root causes of chronic pains with our curated exercises.

Standard or Heavy Firmness?
TPR users have reported relief from both the standard firmness and heavy firmness. However, we recommend ordering based upon your personal preferences and based upon how aggravated your muscle tissue is. The rule of thumb that we use is, if the tissue is very aggravated (>6/10 on the pain scale) we would recommend going with the standard firmness as the heavy firmness will be too intense.

Will the TPR fit me?
The TPR was designed with the understanding that each individual has variations in their body size and type. By changing the positioning of the body while using the TPR, it allows the user to target specific areas to get the maximum benefits. Although you don't have to be a specific height to use the TPR, it is most effective for users between the height range of 5'0" and 6'6". The TPR is also designed to be durable with a max weight capacity of 300 lbs.

How do I properly position the TPR when using it?
We recommend sitting at the base of the product and laying down slowly by walking your hands back. The two top knobs of the TPR are supposed to fit in the suboccipital region of the skull.

  • Power Source
    Operates on 3 AAA batteries (not included), so there are no cords or charging docks to worry about.

Unlike traditional foam rollers or static massage tools, the Pursonic Vibrating Massage Ball  combines vibration therapy with manual pressure for next-level muscle recovery. descriptionHtml:

Step up your planning game with the Infinity Planner!

It's a planner, but not as you know it—undated, unpretentious, and totally under your control.

Wrapped in sleek vegan saffiano leather and secured with a sleek magnetic clasp, it's durable enough to handle coffee spills and life's little oops moments.

Inside, you'll find a world where dates don't dictate your schedule. You start when you want, how you want.

Need to mark your spot? Two ribbons are at your service—because one is never enough.

Flip to the back, and voilà: a yearly calendar sheet (hello, 2026) and a smart metal time tag to clip on and show time who's the boss. And for everything else? Slide it into the handy back pocket—no more crinkled notes or lost receipts!

Whether you're a dreamer, a doer, or a bit of both, the Infinity Planner is your stylish sidekick in a world that won't stand still.

  • Black back cover with gold metallic logo.

  • Secure magnetic flap to keep everything private.

descriptionHtml:

Small but mighty. Stylish but practical. Meet the new and improved BURGA Magnetic Power Bank, your pocket-sized savior with a 5,000 / 10,000 / 15,000 mAh punch. It’s made to keep you charged and turning heads wherever you go.

With a strong N52 magnet, it locks onto MagSafe-compatible devices like it’s meant to be there, offering 7.5W wireless charging for iPhones 12 and up.

Fast-charge any device with PD20W USB-C cable.

We’ve taken power to the next level, wrapped in overcharge and overheating protection, and backed by CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications, because safety never goes out of style.

Important:

  • This power bank magnetically attaches only to iPhones 12 and newer. It will not stick to any other phone models. Wireless charging is designed specifically for MagSafe-compatible iPhones, using Qi technology and delivering up to 7.5W. Some newer Android phones may support wireless charging, but they will not attach magnetically, and alignment is not guaranteed. For all other phones and full charging compatibility, use the included USB-C cable.
  • Magnetic Power Banks do not charge devices up to 100% wirelessly. Expect up to 80% depending on your device model.
  • BURGA Power Banks are not CCC certified and may not be allowed through airport security checks in China.

FEATURES:

  • MagSafe-Compatible: Power Bank designed for wireless charging of MagSafe-compatible iPhones (12 and newer only). Wireless charging may work for some Android models, but the magnet will not attach. Use a USB-C cable for all non-MagSafe phones.
  • PD20W Fast Charging: PD20W USB-C wired charging for Android, Huawei, and Samsung via included USB-C cable.
  • Dual Charging: Charge two devices at once, wirelessly and with a cable.
  • Compact and Durable: Slim design with a scratch-resistant finish and strong N52 magnet.
  • Safety First: Overcharge, over-current, and short-circuit protection with CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications.
  • Fast Recharge: Charge the power bank via a USB-C input port (60W-2V0/3A Type C to C cable included). Power indicator lights show remaining energy levels.
  • Unique Designs: Available in 300+ stunning, fade-proof prints.
  • Perfect Match: Designed to match BURGA’s accessory range, making it easy to mix and match for your style.
  • Printed Surface: The design is printed, not embossed or textured.

This travel mug is your stylish sidekick for enjoying your favorite drinks on the go. Whether you’re commuting, working, or adventuring outdoors, our travel mug keeps your beverages at the perfect temperature and looks fantastic while doing it.

Sizes:

  • 500 ml (17 oz.): H 16.6 cm (6.5 in.) x top W 9 cm (3.5 in.) x bottom W 6.3 cm (2.5 in.) / 247g (8.7 oz.)
  • 700 ml (24 oz.): H 21 cm (8.3 in.) x top W 9 cm (3.5 in.) x bottom W 6.3 cm (2.5 in) / 302g (10.6 oz.)

Two different lid options:

  • Flap Lid: Perfect for hot beverages, keeping them secure and spill-proof.
  • Straw Lid: Ideal for cold drinks, with a convenient straw for easy sipping.

Choose from over 500 unique BURGA designs, each paired with one of four vibrant flap or straw lid colors. Our team matches the lid to the design for a seamless and stylish look.

Key Features:

  • Pure Taste: No residual taste – just pure, fresh-tasting beverages every time.
  • User-Friendly: Easy to clean, one-handed operation, and wide-mouth design for adding ice cubes.
  • Temperature Control:

    • 500 ml (17 oz.) Travel Mug: Keeps drinks hot for 6 hours, cold for 24 hours.

    • 700 ml (24 oz.)Travel Mug: Keeps drinks hot for 6 hours, cold for 24 hours.

  • Premium Materials: BPA-free & lead-free stainless steel with triple-layer insulation.
  • Ergonomic Design: Soft-touch, strong rubber grip for comfortable handling.
  • Non-slip Bottom: Rubber pad for stability and scratch prevention.
  • Leakproof: Secure flap lid design ensures no spills in your bag.
  • Cup Holder Friendly: Fits most cup holders for convenient travel.
  • Designs for Every Taste: 500+ stunning designs and vibrant colors to express your style.
  • NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

Care Instructions:

Wash before first use.

To keep your BURGA travel mug looking vibrant and working flawlessly, hand wash with mild detergent. Avoid abrasive sponges or cleaners, do not put it in the dishwasher or microwave. Avoid prolonged soaking to preserve the color vibrancy.

Smartphones keep growing, but our hands? Not so much. It's a digital juggling act. And let's face it, a dropped phone is a heartbreak no case can fully cushion. So why risk a fumble when you can avoid it?

Meet the BURGA Phone Ring Holder: the tiny hero your phone didn't know it needed. Pop it on the back of your phone, loop a finger through, and voilà! — your tech stays in place, effortlessly. Now that's what we call hands-on security.

Bonus points:

  • You can use it as a stand.
  • Extra stylish & cute.
  • Ultra-strong 3M VHB adhesive pad.
  • No sticky residue after detaching.

* Designed for one-time use, offering strong support for your device. Once removed, our Ring Holders cannot be reused on other cases.

* While the Ring Holder increases grip and reduces the risk of drops, please do not rely on it alone to carry your phone.

title: Aloha - Infinity Planner
descriptionHtml:
Please note: Actual product colors may vary slightly due to materials, lighting, and screen differences.

Step up your planning game with the Infinity Planner!

It's a planner, but not as you know it—undated, unpretentious, and totally under your control.

Wrapped in sleek vegan saffiano leather and secured with a sleek magnetic clasp, it's durable enough to handle coffee spills and life's little oops moments.

Inside, you'll find a world where dates don't dictate your schedule. You start when you want, how you want.

Need to mark your spot? Two ribbons are at your service—because one is never enough.

Flip to the back, and voilà: a yearly calendar sheet (hello, 2026) and a smart metal time tag to clip on and show time who's the boss. And for everything else? Slide it into the handy back pocket—no more crinkled notes or lost receipts!

Whether you're a dreamer, a doer, or a bit of both, the Infinity Planner is your stylish sidekick in a world that won't stand still.

Features:

  • Page size: A5 (148 x 210 mm/5.8 x 8.3 in).
  • 144 pages to plan it all!
  • 100 gsm ivory paper thick enough to protect against ink bleeding.
  • FSC-certified paper to preserve the natural ecosystem.
  • Silk-feel paper texture for pens to glide through smoothly.
  • Vegan faux leather front hardcover with unique stylish designs.
  • Black back cover with gold metallic logo.
  • Built-in back pocket to stash your extras.
  • Metallic time tag: get each month’s days sorted
  • Planners covers dimensions: 151 x 216 x 17 mm/5.9 x 8.5 x 0.7 in.
  • Superior flat-lay binding—no more battling with pages that won't stay put!
  • Secure magnetic flap to keep everything private.
  • 2 black ribbon page markers.
  • Product weight: 454 g/16.01 oz.
  • NOTE: The design is printed – not textured or embossed.

We’ve taken power to the next level, wrapped in overcharge and overheating protection, and backed by CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications, because safety never goes out of style.

Important:

  • This power bank magnetically attaches only to iPhones 12 and newer. It will not stick to any other phone models. Wireless charging is designed specifically for MagSafe-compatible iPhones, using Qi technology and delivering up to 7.5W. Some newer Android phones may support wireless charging, but they will not attach magnetically, and alignment is not guaranteed. For all other phones and full charging compatibility, use the included USB-C cable.
  • Magnetic Power Banks do not charge devices up to 100% wirelessly. Expect up to 80% depending on your device model.
  • BURGA Power Banks are not CCC certified and may not be allowed through airport security checks in China.

FEATURES:

  • MagSafe-Compatible: Power Bank designed for wireless charging of MagSafe-compatible iPhones (12 and newer only). Wireless charging may work for some Android models, but the magnet will not attach. Use a USB-C cable for all non-MagSafe phones.
  • PD20W Fast Charging: PD20W USB-C wired charging for Android, Huawei, and Samsung via included USB-C cable.
  • Dual Charging: Charge two devices at once, wirelessly and with a cable.
  • Compact and Durable: Slim design with a scratch-resistant finish and strong N52 magnet.
  • Safety First: Overcharge, over-current, and short-circuit protection with CE, ROHS, and FCC certifications.
  • Fast Recharge: Charge the power bank via a USB-C input port (60W-2V0/3A Type C to C cable included). Power indicator lights show remaining energy levels.
  • Unique Designs: Available in 300+ stunning, fade-proof prints.
  • Perfect Match: Designed to match BURGA’s accessory range, making it easy to mix and match for your style.
  • Printed Surface: The design is printed, not embossed or textured.
